en.story: Daxiong and Xiaozhi are good friends, they often go out to play together. A-Ming is their classmate, he is always with Xiaozhi every day. One day, Daxiong meets A-Ming in the corridor, but Xiaozhi is not with him. A-Ming looks out the window with a gloomy face. Daxiong asks A-Ming: "How is Xiaozhi?" A-Ming swallows and looks into Daxiong's eyes and says: "Xiaozhi... I am not clear either." A-Ming's answer confuses Daxiong. Later, Daxiong sees Xiaozhi sitting in the corner of the classroom, looking sad. Daxiong walks over, but Xiaozhi pretends not to see.
en.question: Why does Daxiong ask A-Ming how Xiaozhi is?
options: Daxiong just asks casually, wants to tease A-Ming.
Daxiong wants to understand the situation of Xiaozhi.
Daxiong wants to inquire about the relationship between A-Ming and Xiaozhi.
Daxiong admires the friendship between A-Ming and Xiaozhi, wants to get involved.

zh.story: 大雄和小智是好朋友，他们常常一起出去玩。阿明是他们的同学，每天和小智形影不离。一天，大雄在走廊上遇到了阿明，小智却不在他身边。阿明一脸郁闷地看着窗外。大雄问阿明：“小智怎么样了？”阿明吞了吞口水，看着大雄的眼睛说：“小智……我也不清楚。”阿明的回答让大雄有些迷惑。后来，大雄看见小智坐在教室的角落，愁眉苦脸的。大雄走过去，小智却装作没看见。
zh.question: 大雄为什么问阿明小智怎么样了？
options: 大雄只是随口问问，想打趣阿明。
大雄是想了解小智的情况。
大雄想打听阿明和小智的关系。
大雄羡慕阿明和小智的友谊，想插一脚。

en.story: Xiao Ming, Xiao Li, and Xiao Zhang are elementary school students, they often play games together after school. This day, while they are playing on the swing, Xiao Ming sneakily glances at a big apple tree not far from his home. He gives Xiao Li and Xiao Zhang each a candy, then points at the apples on the tree, shows a smile, and turns his head to look at Xiao Li and Xiao Zhang. Xiao Li and Xiao Zhang, upon hearing this, look at the big apple tree, then look at each other and nod.
en.question: What do you think Xiao Li and Xiao Zhang are thinking?
options: Xiao Zhang and Xiao Li are about to set off to help Xiao Ming work.
Xiao Zhang and Xiao Li do not understand what Xiao Ming wants to do.
Xiao Li and Xiao Zhang want to go to Xiao Ming's house to play.
Xiao Li and Xiao Zhang want to eat the apples right away.

zh.story: 小明、小李和小张是小学生，放学后常常一起玩游戏。这天，他们在玩秋千的时候，小明偷偷瞥了一眼距离他家不远的一棵大苹果树。他给小李和小张每人递上一颗糖，然后指着苹果树上的苹果，露出笑容，转过头看向小李和小张。小李和小张闻言都看向了大苹果树，随后相互对视，点了点头。
zh.question: 你觉得小李和小张是怎么想的？
options: 小张和小李将要出发帮小明干活。
小张和小李不明白小明想做什么事。
小李和小张想去小明家玩。
小李和小张想马上吃到苹果。

en.story: In a clear morning, Morning Light is waiting for Dawn in the corridor. They are members of the study club, they plan to attract new members to join. Star is a new classmate who just transfers. Star is walking along the corridor. Morning Light sees Star, quickly glances at Dawn, then smiles at Star. Dawn understands the meaning of Morning Light's eyes, walks to Star with a nervous expression, and matches Morning Light's smile. After a brief conversation with Star, Star responds with a smile.
en.question: Why does Morning Light glance at Dawn after seeing Star?
options: Because Morning Light notices that Dawn's attitude towards Star is a bit abnormal.
To remind Dawn that Star is coming, do not block the way.
To remind Dawn that the study club needs new members, and Star is suitable.
To tell Dawn that Star is a new classmate, it is best to say hello.

zh.story: 在一个清晨，晨光正在走廊上等待晓明。他们都是学习俱乐部的会员，他们打算吸引新的会员加入。星星是刚刚转学过来的新同学，正沿着走廊走过。晨光看到星星，快速地看了晓明一眼，然后向星星微笑。晓明理解了晨光的眼神的含义，带着紧张的表情走到了星星面前，配合晨光的微笑。他们和星星简短的交谈后，星星以一个微笑为回应。
zh.question: 为什么看到星星后，晨光会看晓明一眼？
options: 因为晨光发现晓明对星星的态度有些异常。
要提醒晓明，星星走过来了，不要挡着道。
要提醒晓明学习俱乐部需要新的成员，星星很合适。
要告诉晓明星星是新来的同学，最好去打个招呼示好。

en.story: Xiaohua and Xiaogang are in the corner of the classroom, watching Xiaoli who is dozing off on the seat. Xiaoli has to prepare for an important exam recently, but he is sick and obviously feels uncomfortable. Suddenly, Xiaohua looks at Xiaogang, their eyes meet. In a blog, they find efficient learning materials for the course. He smiles at Xiaogang and nods. Then they walk towards Xiaoli, with Xiaogang holding the magazine in front.
en.question: What do you think Xiaoli thinks?
options: Xiaoli possibly thinks they come to mock him for dozing off before the exam.
Xiaoli possibly thinks they prepare to say something to him, but still feels a bit confused.
Xiaoli possibly thinks they want to show him a boring magazine.
Xiaoli possibly thinks they just pass by, not coming to find him.

zh.story: 小华和小刚在教室的角落里，看着在座位上打瞌睡的小李。小李最近不得不预备一次重要的考试，但他生病了，明显的感觉不舒服。突然，小华看了看小刚，他们眼神交汇。在一篇博客中，他们找到了针对该课程的高效学习材料。他向小刚微笑，点了点头。然后他们向小李走去，小刚拿着杂志走在前面。
zh.question: 你认为小李怎么想？
options: 小李可能会认为他们是来嘲笑自己快考试了还打瞌睡。
小李可能会认为他们准备过来跟自己说什么，但依旧有点疑惑。
小李可能会认为他们想给他看无聊的杂志。
小李可能会认为他们只是路过，并不是来找自己的。

en.story: Xinxin, Jiayi, and Qiaoqiao are in a group, preparing for the end-of-term project meeting. Qiaoqiao chats with other classmates on the side, while Xinxin and Jiayi dedicate themselves to this project. Seeing Jiayi completes a task, Xinxin gives Jiayi an appreciative smile, then gently points at Qiaoqiao who is chatting, and then looks at Jiayi with her eyes. After smiling at Jiayi, Xinxin's face suddenly becomes serious. Qiaoqiao sees Xinxin's pointing and the change in her face.
en.question: How do you think Qiaoqiao feels after seeing Xinxin's behavior?
options: Qiaoqiao feels nervous, thinking that he does not participate in the project.
Qiaoqiao thinks Xinxin has no reason to be angry with him, feels angry.
Qiaoqiao is very happy because he enjoys talking with the classmates next to him.
Qiaoqiao thinks Xinxin is just joking and does not take it seriously.

zh.story: 昕昕、佳怡和乔乔是一个小组，正在为期末的项目会议做准备。乔乔在边上和其他同学聊天，而昕昕和佳怡致力于这个项目。见到佳怡完成了一项工作，昕昕向佳怡投来了一个赞赏的微笑，然后轻轻指了指正在聊天的乔乔，紧接着用眼神看向了佳怡，在对佳怡微笑之后，昕昕的脸色突然变得严肃起来。乔乔看到了昕昕的指指点点和脸色的变化。
zh.question: 你认为乔乔看到昕昕的行为后心情怎么样？
options: 乔乔感到紧张，觉得自己没有努力参与到项目中。
乔乔觉得昕昕没有理由对他生气，感到愤怒。
乔乔很开心，因为他与边上的同学相谈甚欢。
乔乔认为昕昕只是开个玩笑，并没有把这个当回事。

en.story: In a school project, Jie Jie, Lin Lin, and Hao Hao are a team of partners. They need to complete a complex project together. Jie Jie and Lin Lin obviously have more technical talent than Hao Hao, but Hao Hao thinks highly of himself. One day, Jie Jie suddenly stops the work in his hands, gives a look to Lin Lin, and then looks at Hao Hao. Jie Jie smiles lightly and nods to Lin Lin. Lin Lin understands his look and walks to Hao Hao to give him a marginal task. Hao Hao does not notice the exchange between Jie Jie and Lin Lin, but he notices the difference in task difficulty among the three of them.
en.question: What do you think Hao Hao thinks now?
options: Hao Hao is a bit angry, thinking that Jie Jie and Lin Lin look down on his technical level.
Hao Hao feels happy because he thinks Jie Jie and Lin Lin respect him and arrange suitable tasks for him.
Hao Hao feels angry because he has a premonition that he is going to be responsible for a difficult task.
Hao Hao feels confused because he cannot understand the interaction between Jie Jie and Lin Lin.

zh.story: 在一个学校项目中，杰杰、林林和昊昊是一组合作伙伴。他们需要共同完成一个复杂的项目。杰杰和林林明显比昊昊更有技术才华，但昊昊自视甚高。一天，杰杰突然停下手中的工作，用眼神向林林示意，然后看向昊昊。杰杰轻轻笑了笑，对林林点了点头。林林理解了他的眼神，走向昊昊交给他一个边缘的任务。昊昊没有注意杰杰和林林的交流，但发现了他们三个之间任务难度的差异。
zh.question: 你觉得昊昊现在怎么想？
options: 昊昊有些愤怒，认为杰杰和林林瞧不上他的技术水平。
昊昊感到很愉快，因为他觉得杰杰和林林在尊重他，并给他安排合适的任务。
昊昊感到生气，因为他有预感他将要被负责一个困难的任务。
昊昊感到迷茫，因为他无法理解杰杰和林林间的互动意义。

en.story: Minghan, Yulin, and Binbin are members of a research group, and they are conducting an important research topic. One day, they meet in the lab to discuss the progress of the project. Minghan keeps looking at his phone, not saying a word, but he occasionally glances at Yulin. Binbin buries his head in the experiment, and he sees Minghan's gaze at Yulin. Suddenly, Minghan winks at Yulin and points to his task materials, then he lowers his head to reply to the phone message. Yulin sees it, sneers, and continues to be busy with her work.
en.question: How do you think Yulin views Minghan's behavior?
options: Yulin finds Minghan's behavior interesting, she likes his sense of humor.
Yulin does not notice Minghan's wink, she only focuses on her own work.
Yulin despises Minghan's behavior, she does not want to deal with Minghan's request.
Yulin is confused by Minghan's behavior, she does not know what he wants to express.

zh.story: 明汉、玉琳和彬彬是一个研究小组的成员，正在进行一个重要的课题研究。一天，他们在实验室碰头讨论项目进度。明汉一直看着他的手机，一句话也没说，但他偶尔看一眼玉琳。彬彬埋头做实验，他看到了明汉对玉琳的目光。突然，明汉对玉琳挤了挤眼，并指向自己的任务资料，随后又低头回复手机消息。玉琳看见后，冷笑了一声，继续忙于自己的工作。
zh.question: 你觉得玉琳如何看待明汉的行为？
options: 玉琳对明汉的行为感到有趣，她喜欢他的幽默感。
玉琳没注意到明汉的挤眼，她只关注自己的工作。
玉琳对明汉的行为感到不屑，她不想理会明汉的请求。
玉琳对明汉的行为感到困惑，她不知道他想要表达什么。

en.story: Mingfeng, Xiaoyu, and Xiaolin are good friends. This afternoon, Mingfeng watches Xiaoyu and her newly adopted pet dog play under the shade of the trees in the community. Suddenly, he winks at Xiaolin who is next to him, and looks at the nearby pet supply store. Xiaolin looks at Xiaoyu, then responds to Mingfeng's gaze. After that, she stands up and walks towards the pet supply store.
en.question: What do you think Xiaoyu thinks?
options: Xiaoyu feels angry, she thinks Mingfeng and Xiaolin have secrets they do not share with her.
Xiaoyu feels puzzled and somewhat confused about their behavior.
Xiaoyu thinks Mingfeng and Xiaolin do not like her new pet.
Xiaoyu feels a bit sad about Xiaolin's departure, thinking she does not like to play.

zh.story: 铭锋、小玉和晓琳是好朋友。今天下午，铭锋在小区的树荫下看小玉和她新领养的宠物狗玩耍。突然，他对旁边的晓琳挤了挤眼，并看向近处的宠物用品商店。晓琳看了看小玉，然后回应了铭锋的眼神。随后，她站了起来，向宠物用品商店走去。
zh.question: 你认为小玉怎么想？
options: 小玉觉得生气，她觉得铭锋和小玉有秘密不跟她分享。
小玉对两人的行为感到困惑和有些不解。
小玉觉得铭锋和晓琳都不喜欢她的新宠物。
小玉对晓琳的离开感到有些难过，以为她不喜欢玩耍。

en.story: The night is deep, and everyone in the community immerses in sweet dreams. Suddenly, Xiao Chen turns the stereo to the highest level, playing songs loudly. Xiao Guang and Xiao Li wake up because of the noise. They step onto the balcony and see Xiao Chen on the balcony of the opposite building, laughing at them with schadenfreude. Xiao Li frowns, prepares to confront Xiao Chen, and picks up a baseball bat. At this moment, Xiao Guang stops Xiao Li, waves at Xiao Li, and then walks downstairs. Xiao Chen sees Xiao Guang coming from the corridor.
en.question: Xiao Chen sees Xiao Guang coming over, how does he feel?
options: Xiao Chen feels excited, thinking he can continue to prank.
Xiao Chen feels nervous and surprised, he does not expect Xiao Guang to come directly to him to solve the problem.
Xiao Chen does not care, he thinks Xiao Guang just comes to play with him.
Xiao Chen feels depressed, because Xiao Li does not come with Xiao Guang.

zh.story: 夜深了，小区里的人都沉浸在甜甜的睡梦中。突然，小陈把音响调到最高档，大声播放歌曲。小光和小李都被吵醒了。他们踏上阳台，看到小陈在对面楼的阳台幸灾乐祸地看着他们笑。小李皱紧眉头，准备去找小陈理论，并拿上了棒球棍。这时小光却拦住了小李，并对小李摆了摆手，然后走下楼。小陈看到小光从走廊走了过来。
zh.question: 小陈看到小光走过来，他的心情如何？
options: 小陈感到兴奋，认为可以继续恶作剧。
小陈感到紧张和惊讶，他没想到小光会直接过来找他解决问题。
小陈不以为意，他以为小光只是来找他玩。
小陈感到沮丧，因为小李没有和小光一起过来。

en.story: In a community event, Ali, Dahao, and Xiaofei are the candidate volunteers. Ali is the chairperson of the residents' committee, she needs to appoint a volunteer to be in charge of the patrol work for the coming week, this is a job with a gray income. At the beginning of the meeting, Ali walks to the front and gives a speech, then turns to Dahao, and says in a challenging tone: "Dahao, do you have confidence to take on this heavy responsibility?" Dahao does not respond, and Ali knows that his legs are a bit inconvenient. Ali smiles and turns to Xiaofei, says in the same tone: "Xiaofei, do you have the courage to take this challenge?" Xiaofei immediately nods and agrees. Ali finally chooses Xiaofei to be in charge of the patrol work in the residential area.
en.question: What do you think Xiaofei's mood is?
options: Xiaofei feels happy and excited.
Xiaofei feels a bit ashamed and uneasy because of this.
Xiaofei feels confused and surprised at Ali's behavior.
Xiaofei feels angry and betrayed about becoming a patrolman.

zh.story: 在社区的一次活动中，阿丽，大豪和小飞是候选的志愿者。阿丽是居委会主席，她需要选出一位义工来负责接下来一周的巡逻工作，这是一项有灰色收入的工作。在会议开始的时候，阿丽走到前面发表了一段演讲，然后转向大豪，以挑战的语气说：“大豪，你有信心接手这项重任吗？”大豪不置可否，而阿丽知道他的腿脚本身就有些微不便。阿丽微笑后转向小飞，用相同的语气说：“小飞，你有勇气接这个挑战吗？”小飞马上点头答应。阿丽最后选择了小飞来负责居民区的巡逻工作。
zh.question: 你认为小飞的心情如何？
options: 小飞感到高兴和振奋。
小飞因此感到有些羞愧和不安。
小飞对于阿丽的行为感到困惑和惊讶。
小飞对于成为巡逻人员一事感到愤怒和被背叛。

en.story: Old Wang's garden is the best looking in the community, he always takes good care of it. Recently, he needs to go out for a month, and he is very concerned about the garden. Ah Yang and Beibei are two novice gardening enthusiasts in the community, they take care of their small gardens every day. One evening, Beibei is collecting clothes on the balcony. Old Wang walks over, looks at her, then turns his head to look at Ah Yang's garden. He finally sets his gaze on the small garden in front of Beibei's door, then looks at Beibei and smiles. After that, he tells Beibei that he is about to go out for a while.
en.question: Why does Old Wang look at his own garden and Ah Yang's garden and then smile at Beibei?
options: Old Wang thinks that Ah Yang and Beibei's gardens are not as good as his own.
Old Wang is proud of his garden, and he smiles at Beibei to express this emotion.
Old Wang finds through observation that Beibei is more suitable to take care of his garden than Ah Yang.
Old Wang wants to share the fun things in the garden with Beibei.

zh.story: 老王的花园是社区内最好看的，他总是呵护有加。最近他需要外出一个月，很是挂念花园。阿杨和贝贝是小区里两位新手园艺热衷者，他们每天都会照顾各自的小花园。一天晚上，贝贝正在阳台上收衣服。老王走过来，望了望她，然后转过头看阿杨的花园。他最后将目光定在了贝贝门前的小花园，然后看向贝贝，笑了笑。之后他告诉贝贝，他马上就要外出一段时间。
zh.question: 为什么老王看向自己的花园和阿杨的花园然后朝贝贝笑？
options: 老王认为阿杨和贝贝的花园都不如自己的好。
老王对自己的花园感到骄傲，笑向贝贝是想表达这种情绪。
老王通过观察发现贝贝比阿杨更适合照顾他的花园。
老王想和贝贝分享花园中的趣事。

en.story: An important basketball game is in progress. Tianba is an important player on the opposing team, while Xuehang and Xiaohao are players on our team. When the game comes to match point, Tianba does not get the ball well, and Xiaohao quickly grabs it. When Xuehang responds to Xiaohao, he quickly and quietly says a few words to Xiaohao. Xiaohao's expression looks a bit stiff, then he raises his head and looks at Xuehang in surprise. Then, Xiaohao passes the ball to Xuehang, and Xuehang launches a low-level attack. When the referee blows the whistle, Xiaohao and Xuehang's team loses the game.
en.question: Why does Xuehang come over and talk to Xiaohao?
options: Xuehang wants to remind Xiaohao to defend against their opponent Tianba.
Xuehang finds that Xiaohao's game strategy has problems and wants to give him advice.
Xuehang wants to tell Xiaohao that their club is betting on the game and they must deliberately lose the game.
Xuehang wants Xiaohao to pass the ball to him so he can score.

zh.story: 一场重要的篮球比赛正在进行中。天霸是对手队的重要球员，而学航和小豪是我们队伍的球员。比赛来到赛点的时候，天霸没有很好地拿到球，小豪则迅速抢了过去。学航接应小豪的时候，快速地和小豪悄悄说了几句话。小豪的表情看起来有点僵硬，随后抬起头惊讶地看着学航。接着，小豪将球传给了学航，学航发动了一次低水平的进攻。当裁判吹响笛子的时候，小豪和学航的队伍输掉了比赛。
zh.question: 学航为什么要跑过来与小豪说话？
options: 学航想提醒小豪做好防守对手天霸的任务。
学航发现小豪的比赛策略有问题，想给他提建议。
学航想告知小豪，他们俱乐部赌球了，必须故意输掉比赛。
学航想让小豪传球给他，这样他可以取分。

en.story: Xiaodong, Xiaoxi, and Xiaonan are playing a flying chess game. Xiaonan is the birthday boy today, he is playing the game with full concentration, without paying attention to anything else. Xiaodong and Xiaoxi often exchange glances during the game, occasionally smiling slightly. Xiaodong quietly shows his chess piece to Xiaoxi. Xiaoxi looks at the chess piece in Xiaodong's hand, then glances at Xiaonan, then nods. In the subsequent game, although Xiaodong and Xiaoxi are competitors, they cooperate cleverly several times, and in the end, Xiaonan wins the game.
en.question: What do you think Xiaonan thinks?
options: Xiaonan thinks they are playing unfairly, he is a bit unhappy.
Xiaonan does not understand why they cooperate in secret, he feels puzzled.
Xiaonan notices their interaction, but he does not think too much.
Xiaonan is happy to win the game.

zh.story: 晓东、晓西和晓南正在玩飞行棋游戏。晓南是今天的生日男孩，正在全神贯注地玩着游戏，无暇关注其他。晓东和晓西在游戏进程中经常交换眼神，偶尔微微笑。晓东悄悄向晓西展示了他的棋子。晓西看了看晓东手中的棋子，然后瞥向晓南，然后点了点头。随后的游戏中，晓东和晓西虽然是竞争对手，却有几次很巧妙的配合，最后是晓南赢得了比赛。
zh.question: 你认为晓南怎么想？
options: 晓南觉得他们玩得不公平，有点不快。
晓南不明白为什么他们在暗中合作，感到百思不得其解。
晓南注意到他们的互动，但并没有过多思考。
晓南很高兴能赢下比赛。

en.story: Xiaoliu and Xiaoming are good friends, they like mountain climbing and exploring. They plan a new outdoor activity. At this time, Xiaoliu thinks about whether to invite Xiaoyun, who likes mountain biking, to join the journey. Xiaoliu looks at Xiaoming, signals him to look at Xiaoyun with his eyes, and then shakes his head with a smile. Then, he throws an expectant look at Xiaoming, as if hinting at something. Xiaoming watches this process, seems to understand Xiaoliu's intention, so he decides to actively talk to Xiaoyun about this activity. Xiaoming and Xiaoyun talk for a few minutes, Xiaoyun hesitates at first, then nods.
en.question: How do you think Xiao Yun feels?
options: Xiao Yun feels rejected because she sees Xiao Liu shake his head at Xiao Ming.
Xiao Yun feels lost because she is not directly invited to participate in the activity.
Xiao Yun hesitates at first, then happily participates in the outdoor activity.
Xiao Yun thinks she might be invited to their activity, feels excited.

zh.story: 小柳和小明是好友，喜欢登山探险。他们筹划起了新的户外活动。此时，小柳在思考是否该邀请喜欢山地骑行的小云一起加入旅程。小柳看着小明，用眼神示意他向小云看去，然后微笑着摇了摇头。接着，他又朝小明投去期待的眼神，仿佛在默示着什么。小明看着这个过程，似乎了解了小柳的意图，于是决定主动和小云谈论这次活动。小明和小云交谈了几分钟，小云起初犹豫不决，随后点了点头。
zh.question: 你觉得小云的心情如何？
options: 小云感到被排斥，因为她看到小柳向小明摇头。
小云感到失落，因为她没有被直接邀请参加活动。
小云起初在犹豫，随后高兴地参与了户外活动。
小云觉得自己可能会被邀请参加他们的活动，感到兴奋。

en.story: Xiaohua and Xiaoyu are members of the hiking club, they are planning a hike next week. Xiaoyan is new and she never participates in such activities. Xiaohua looks at Xiaoyu, gently points to the date of the trip next week, and looks at Xiaoyan, but says nothing. Xiaohua looks at Xiaoyu, the two exchange knowing smiles, and together they walk towards Xiaoyan. Xiaoyan notices their gaze and smiles.
en.question: Why does Xiaohua look at Xiaoyu and then at Xiaoyan, while pointing to the date of the trip next week?
options: Xiaohua hopes to remind Xiaoyu of the date of the hike next week.
Xiaohua and Xiaoyu want to seek Xiaoyan's advice.
Xiaohua notices an important announcement and wants to share it with Xiaoyu and Xiaoyan.
Xiaohua and Xiaoyu are hinting at inviting Xiaoyan to join the hike next week.

zh.story: 小华和小宇是徒步俱乐部的成员，他们正在计划下周的一次徒步旅行。小燕是新加入的，她一直没有参加过类似的活动。小华看向小宇，轻轻地点了点下周的旅行日期，并看向小燕，但没有说出任何事情。小华望向小宇，两人互相交换了会心的笑容，并一同向小燕走去。小燕注意到了他们的眼神和笑容。
zh.question: 为什么小华看向小宇并随后看向小燕，同时点了点下周的旅行日期？
options: 小华希望提醒小宇下周的徒步旅行日期。
小华和小宇想寻求小燕的建议。
小华注意到了一个重要的公告，想要分享给小宇和小燕。
小华和小宇在暗示邀请小燕参加下周的徒步旅行。

en.story: Xiaohua and Xiaoyu are members of the hiking club, they are planning a hike next week. Xiaoyan is new and she never participates in such activities. Xiaohua looks at Xiaoyu, gently points to the date of the trip next week, and looks at Xiaoyan, but says nothing. Xiaohua looks at Xiaoyu, the two exchange knowing smiles, and together they walk towards Xiaoyan. Xiaoyan notices their gaze and smiles.
en.question: What do you think Xiaoyan's mood is at this time?
options: Xiaoyan feels scared, she thinks Xiaoming and Xiaohua are trying to provoke her.
Xiaoyan feels confused, not clear why they come.
Xiaoyan feels surprised, looking forward to the hike next week.
Xiaoyan feels happy, because she is included in the plan by Xiaohua and Xiaoyu.

zh.story: 小华和小宇是徒步俱乐部的成员，他们正在计划下周的一次徒步旅行。小燕是新加入的，她一直没有参加过类似的活动。小华看向小宇，轻轻地点了点下周的旅行日期，并看向小燕，但没有说出任何事情。小华望向小宇，两人互相交换了会心的笑容，并一同向小燕走去。小燕注意到了他们的眼神和笑容。
zh.question: 你觉得小燕此时的心情是怎么样？
options: 小燕感到害怕，她觉得小明和小华是想来挑衅她。
小燕感到困惑，不清楚他们来的原因。
小燕感到惊喜，期待下周的徒步旅行。
小燕感到高兴，因为她被小华和小宇包括在了计划中。

en.story: Lele and Xiaowei are in an outdoor sports equipment store, choosing climbing gear. They plan to participate in an upcoming climbing course, but they still lack a team member. While they are chatting, they see Qingqing in the park across the street through the glass window of the shop. Qingqing also notices them and waves at them. Lele suddenly smiles at Xiaowei, purses her lips, and points at Qingqing in the park. Xiaowei looks over with interest. Then, Lele gets up and leaves the store, and Xiaowei quickly follows and walks towards Qingqing.
en.question: Why does Lele suddenly smile at Xiaowei and point at Qingqing?
options: Lele smiles because she sees Qingqing having fun in the park.
Lele smiles because she thinks Xiaowei also likes to make friends with Qingqing.
Lele smiles because she wants to suggest to Xiaowei to consider inviting Qingqing to join the climbing course.
Lele smiles because she just sees a joke she knows before.

zh.story: 乐乐和小伟正在一家户外运动器材店里选购攀岩装备。他们计划参加一个即将开班的攀岩课程，但还缺少一名组团的队友。他们在聊天的时候，透过店铺的玻璃窗看到了对面公园里的青青。青青正好也注意到他们，并举手打了个招呼。乐乐突然对小伟笑了笑，抿了抿嘴，并指了指公园那边的青青，小伟饶有兴趣地看了过去。接着，乐乐起身走出了店铺，而小伟很快就跟了上去并向青青走去。
zh.question: 乐乐为什么会突然对小伟笑了笑，并指了指青青？
options: 乐乐笑是因为看到青青在公园玩得开心。
乐乐笑是因为他觉得小伟也会喜欢和青青交朋友。
乐乐笑是因为他想建议小伟一起考虑要不要拉青青一起加入攀岩课程。
乐乐笑是因为他刚好看到了一个他之前的笑话。

en.story: Lele and Xiaowei are in an outdoor sports equipment store, choosing climbing gear. They plan to participate in an upcoming climbing course, but they still lack a team member. While they are chatting, they see Qingqing in the park across the street through the glass window of the shop. Qingqing also notices them and waves at them. Lele suddenly smiles at Xiaowei, purses her lips, and points at Qingqing in the park. Xiaowei looks over with interest. Then, Lele gets up and leaves the store, and Xiaowei quickly follows and walks towards Qingqing.
en.question: Qingqing notices Lele and Xiaowei walking towards her, what is her mood?
options: Qingqing feels surprised because she does not expect to see them in the park.
Qingqing feels curious, wanting to know what they are buying in the equipment store.
Qingqing feels curious, not knowing why Lele and Xiaowei come out of the outdoor sports equipment store to find her.
Qingqing feels scared, thinking they will invite her to participate in dangerous sports.

zh.story: 乐乐和小伟正在一家户外运动器材店里选购攀岩装备。他们计划参加一个即将开班的攀岩课程，但还缺少一名组团的队友。他们在聊天的时候，透过店铺的玻璃窗看到了对面公园里的青青。青青正好也注意到他们，并举手打了个招呼。乐乐突然对小伟笑了笑，抿了抿嘴，并指了指公园那边的青青，小伟饶有兴趣地看了过去。接着，乐乐起身走出了店铺，而小伟很快就跟了上去并向青青走去。
zh.question: 青青注意到乐乐和小伟向她走来，她的心情应该是？
options: 青青感到意外，因为她没有想到会在公园见到他们。
青青感到好奇，想知道他们在器材店买什么。
青青感到好奇，不知道乐乐和小伟为什么从户外运动器材店出来找她。
青青感到害怕，以为他们会邀请她参加危险的运动。

en.story: Xiaoxia and Xiaoliang are good friends, they both like the same girl - Xiaomei. One weekend afternoon, Xiaoxia, Xiaoliang, and Xiaomei go to the park to skate together. Xiaoliang suddenly falls, Xiaomei is the first to rush up to care for him. Xiaoxia watches from the side, there seems to be some confusion in his eyes, he carefully observes the actions of Xiaoliang and Xiaomei, then he seems thoughtful, there seems to be some urgency. Afterwards, Xiaoxia distracts Xiaoliang, finds Xiaomei alone, and tries to give a small box to Xiaomei, saying, "This is for you." and carefully observes Xiaomei's subsequent performance.
en.question: Why does Xiaoxia give Xiaomei that small box?
options: Xiaoxia just helps Xiaoliang to pass the gift to Xiaomei.
Xiaoxia thanks Xiaomei for caring about Xiaoliang, the gift is to express gratitude.
Xiaoxia hopes to judge whether Xiaomei has feelings for Xiaoliang by whether Xiaomei accepts what he gives.
Xiaoxia just happens to have an extra small box to give to Xiaomei.

zh.story: 小夏和小亮是好友，他们共同喜欢同一个女孩——小美。一个周末的午后，小夏、小亮和小美一起去公园溜冰。小亮突然摔倒，小美第一个冲上前去关心他。小夏在旁边看着，眼神中似乎有些疑惑，他仔细观察着小亮和小美的举动，随后他若有所思，似乎有一些紧迫感。事后，小夏支开小亮，单独找到小美，并尝试把一个小盒子递给小美说：“这是送给你的。”并仔细地观察着小美的接下来的表现。
zh.question: 小夏为什么送小美那个小盒子？
options: 小夏只是帮小亮转交礼物给小美。
小夏感谢小美对小亮的关心，赠送礼物是为了表达谢意。
小夏希望通过小美是否接受他送的东西来判断小美是否对小亮有感情。
小夏只是碰巧有一个多余的小盒子想给小美。

en.story: Xiao Gang and Xiao Fen are classmates, Xiao Yun has a general relationship with them. One afternoon, Xiao Gang whispers to Xiao Fen in the corner of the classroom. Xiao Yun sees their interaction from a distance, but does not hear what they are talking about. She only sees Xiao Gang smiling at Xiao Fen, carefully spreading out a movie ticket, and then blinking at Xiao Fen. Suddenly, Xiao Gang notices Xiao Yun watching them and alerts Xiao Fen. Xiao Fen immediately puts away the movie ticket and greets Xiao Yun with Xiao Gang. Xiao Yun sees the whole process.
en.question: Why does Xiao Gang alert Xiao Fen when he sees Xiao Yun watching them?
options: Xiao Gang has more movie tickets and wants to invite Xiao Yun to watch the movie together.
Xiao Gang wants to go to the movies with Xiao Fen alone.
Xiao Gang wants Xiao Fen to greet Xiao Yun.
Xiao Gang wants Xiao Fen to ask Xiao Yun about her opinion on the movie.

zh.story: 小刚和小芬是同班同学，小芸和他们的关系一般。一天下午，小刚在教室角落与小芬互道悄悄话。小芸从远处看到他们的互动，但听不见他们在谈论什么。她只看到小刚向小芬微笑，并细心地摊开一张电影票，然后对小芬一下下地眨眼睛。突然，小刚注意到小芸在看着他们，并提醒了小芬。小芬马上将电影票收了起来，并和小刚一起向小芸打了招呼。小芸看到了整个过程。
zh.question: 为什么小刚看到小芸在看他们时，会提醒小芬？
options: 小刚还有电影票，想邀请小芸一起去看电影。
小刚想和小芬两个人去看电影。
小刚想让小芬和小芸打招呼。
小刚想让小芬询问小芸对电影的看法。

en.story: Jianjian and Jingjing are classmates, their relationship is not very close, although they often chat but they usually do not go home together after school. One day, when school is about to end, Xuanxuan joins their chat. Jianjian takes the opportunity when Jingjing turns her head to talk to Xuanxuan, makes a movie-watching gesture to Xuanxuan, then smiles at Xuanxuan, Xuanxuan also nods to Jianjian, both of them smile at Jingjing. After school, Jianjian and Xuanxuan leave the school together.
en.question: Why do Jianjian and Xuanxuan exchange a smile?
options: Jianjian hopes Xuanxuan helps him invite Jingjing to watch a movie together in a few days.
Jianjian wants to signal to Xuanxuan, he wants to watch a movie alone with Xuanxuan, do not invite Jingjing.
Jianjian thinks of a movie-related joke, wants to share with Xuanxuan.
Jianjian and Xuanxuan together, secretly make fun of Jingjing.

zh.story: 剑剑和菁菁是同班同学，他们关系并不是很亲近，虽然经常闲聊但放学一般不会一起回家。某天快放学的时候，萱萱加入到他们的聊天中。剑剑趁菁菁转头对萱萱说话，向萱萱做了一个看电影的手势，随后和萱萱对视一笑，萱萱也向剑剑点了点头，两人一起向菁菁笑了笑。放学后，剑剑和萱萱一起离开了学校。
zh.question: 为什么剑剑和萱萱对视一笑？
options: 剑剑希望萱萱帮助他邀请菁菁过几天一起去看电影。
剑剑想示意萱萱，他想和萱萱单独看电影，不要约菁菁一起去。
剑剑想到了有关电影的笑话，想和萱萱分享。
剑剑和萱萱一起，暗地里取笑菁菁。

en.story: Yu Xuan and Xiao Qing are a couple, but recently they have some misunderstandings due to some minor issues, and communication is difficult. On the same day, they both go to the local stall market. The old lady sees Yu Xuan and proposes that they exchange a bouquet of flowers as a symbol of reconciliation. Yu Xuan looks at Xiao Qing, nods secretly, and among various bouquets, he picks a blooming sunflower. The old lady gives him the sunflower, and after he takes it, he looks back at Xiao Qing, but Xiao Qing is looking at other stalls at this time. Yu Xuan silently puts the flowers in her shopping bag.
en.question: What do you think Xiao Qing's reaction is when she sees the sunflower?
options: Xiao Qing sees the sunflower and thinks Yu Xuan is too stingy, and she gets even more angry.
Xiao Qing sees the sunflower and feels confused, she does not understand Yu Xuan's intention.
Xiao Qing sees the sunflower and understands Yu Xuan's intention, she may be moved.
Xiao Qing sees the sunflower and doesn't care, because she does not like flowers.

zh.story: 宇轩和晓晴是一对恋人，但最近因一些小事有些误会，难以沟通。同一天，他们都去逛了当地的摊位市场。老婆婆看见宇轩，提议让他们互换一束花作为和好的象征。宇轩看了晓晴一眼，暗自点了点头，在各种花束中，挑选了一束盛开的向日葵。老婆婆递给他那束向日葵，他接过来后又回头看了看晓晴，可晓晴此时却在看别的摊位。宇轩默默地把花放在她的购物袋里。
zh.question: 你认为晓晴看到向日葵会有什么样的反应？
options: 晓晴看到向日葵，会觉得宇轩太小气，变得更加生气。
晓晴看到向日葵，会感到困惑，理解不了宇轩的意图。
晓晴看到向日葵，会明白宇轩的用心，或许会感动。
晓晴看到向日葵会觉得无所谓，因为她不喜欢花朵。

en.story: Dongdong and Xiaoning are colleagues in the same company, they make a date to see the night view tonight. Xiaoning does not know about Dongdong's love history. Before leaving, Dongdong smiles as he looks at the photo he takes for Xiaoning, and he even rents a convertible sports car, preparing to give Xiaoning a surprise. When he leaves the house, Dongdong's ex-girlfriend Ruirui just passes by Dongdong's house. They do not speak, but Ruirui notices the photo and car key in Dongdong's hand, and she sneers. At this time, Xiaoning also arrives at Dongdong's house, she sees Ruirui's expression.
en.question: Why does Dongdong smile when he looks at Xiaoning's photo?
options: Dongdong accidentally sees the funny scene in Xiaoning's photo.
Dongdong smiles because he feels excited and anticipates about seeing Xiaoning soon.
Dongdong sees the scenery in the photo, and he recalls the fun of the last trip.
Dongdong thinks of other fun things through the photo, his laughter has nothing to do with Xiaoning.

zh.story: 冬冬和小宁是同一个公司的同事，他们今天晚上约定去看夜景。小宁对冬冬的恋爱史并不清楚。临行前，冬冬笑着看着他给小宁拍的照片，还特意租了一辆敞篷跑车，准备给小宁一个惊喜。出门的时候，冬冬的前女友瑞瑞刚好经过冬冬家门口。他们没说话，但是瑞瑞注意到了冬冬手上的照片和车钥匙，冷笑了一声。此时，小宁也到了冬冬家门口，她看到了瑞瑞的表情。
zh.question: 为什么冬冬看着小宁的照片会笑？
options: 冬冬无意间看到了小宁的照片中的搞笑镜头。
冬冬笑是因为他对即将见到小宁感到激动和期待。
冬冬看见照片里的风景，回想起上次旅行的趣事。
冬冬通过照片联想到了别的趣事，他笑起来和小宁无关。

en.story: Xiaoxia, Xiaobai, and Xiaonan are classmates, they are preparing a group report. Xiaoxia, as the team leader, is responsible for assigning tasks to the three of them today. But Xiaoxia and Xiaobai have already discussed, they hope to let Xiaonan do more parts. During the discussion, Xiaoxia gives examples to explain the skills needed for the task, and looks at Xiaobai, saying: "Xiaobai, this part of the task is very important and a bit difficult, can you complete it?" Xiaobai immediately replies: "I already take on the work of other parts and start doing it." At this time, Xiaonan notices that they are looking at him together, but they do not speak.
en.question: What do you think Xiaonan feels at that time?
options: Xiaonan feels happy and confident about the important task she is assigned.
Xiaonan feels that she is ignored and excluded by Xiaoxia and Xiaobai.
Xiaonan feels a bit stunned, she does not expect this complex task to fall on her.
Xiaonan feels angry because she resents Xiaoxia and Xiaobai for discussing in advance to deal with her.

zh.story: 小夏、小白和小楠是同学，他们正在准备一项小组报告。小夏身为组长，今天负责为三人分配任务。但小夏与小白已经商量好，他们希望能够让小楠做更多的部分。在讨论过程中，小夏在举例子讲解任务需要的技术时，和小白对视了一眼，说：”小白，这个部分的任务很重要，也有点难，你能完成吗？”小白随即回答：“我已经承担了别的部分的工作，并且已经开始做了。”这时小楠发现他们一起注视着自己，但并没有说话。
zh.question: 你认为小楠当时有什么感觉？
options: 小楠对于她被分配的重要任务感到开心并且有信心。
小楠觉得自己已经被小夏和小白忽视和排斥了。
小楠感到有点懵，没想到这个复杂的任务落到了自己头上。
小楠感到愤怒，因为她很反感小夏和小白提前商量好对付她。

en.story: Sakura is the leader of the group, and the group is carrying out an academic project. Komatsu and Nan are team members, they are currently competing in the competition and completing the work with Yi. Yi is a new transfer student, he has similar competition experience, he is quite shy. In the shared workspace, Komatsu and Nan are sharing their ideas, while Yi sits between them, quietly looking at the materials in his hands. Sakura sees this scene, smiles lightly, then whispers a few words to Komatsu and Nan, Komatsu and Nan both nod. Then, Sakura walks to Yi's side, pats his shoulder with a smile, says a few words, then walks away. Yi takes the initiative to look at Komatsu and Nan, finds that they are also looking at him.
en.question: What is Yi's possible mood now?
options: Yi possibly feels very frustrated, because he thinks Sakura questions his ability.
Yi possibly resents Sakura's reminder, he prefers to work alone.
Yi possibly hesitates about Sakura's encouragement, but still prepares to act.
Yi thinks Komatsu and Nanami lower the efficiency of completing the work.

zh.story: 小樱是小组的负责人，小组正在进行一项学术项目。小松和小楠是团队成员，他们目前正在竞赛中和小易一起完成作品。小易是新来的转学生，他有过类似竞赛的经验，他比较腼腆。在共享的工作空间里，小松和小楠在分享他们的想法，而小易坐在他们中间，静静地看着手中的资料。小樱看见这一幕，轻轻笑了一下，然后小声对小松和小楠说了几句轻声私语的话，小松和小楠都点了点头。接着，小樱走到小易的身边，笑着拍了拍他的肩膀，说了几句话后，便走开了。小易主动看向小松和小楠，发现他们也在看他。
zh.question: 小易现在可能是什么心情？
options: 小易可能感到很有沮丧，因为他觉得小樱质疑他的能力。
小易可能对小樱的提醒有些反感，他更喜欢一个人工作。
小易可能对小樱的鼓励有些犹豫，但仍准备行动。
小易觉得小松和小楠会降低完成作品的效率。

en.story: The teacher announces a five-minute break, and Xiao Yu looks at Xiao Jie, seeming a bit anxious in his eyes. Xiao Jie is reading a comic and doesn't pay much attention to him. Xiao Yu looks around at his classmates, looks down at his homework, and then stares at Xiao Jie again. This time, Xiao Jie looks up at Xiao Yu for a few seconds, then lowers his head to continue reading his comic. Xiao Yu glances at the teacher's position again. After the bell rings at the end of the break, Xiao Yu gives Xiao Jie a look again. At this time, the teacher re-enters the classroom and tells the students that he is about to start grading homework. At this moment, Xiao Jie looks shocked and shows a surprised expression.
en.question: What does Xiao Jie feel after hearing the teacher's words?
options: Xiao Jie feels scared and fearful because he is reading comics all the time and doesn't finish his homework.
Xiao Jie is very happy because he starts reading comics after finishing his homework, so he doesn't need to worry.
Xiao Jie feels indifferent, he doesn't care about homework and the teacher's behavior.
Xiao Jie feels curious, he wants to know how others do their homework.

zh.story: 老师宣布休息五分钟，写完作业的小宇望了望小杰，眼神里似乎有些着急。小杰正在看漫画，没有太注意他。小宇看了看周围的同学们，低头看了看自己的作业，又盯着小杰。这次，小杰抬头看了看小宇几秒钟，然后低头继续看他的漫画。小宇又瞟了一眼老师的位置。在休息结束的铃声响起后，小宇又向小杰使眼色。这时老师重新进入教室，告诉同学们他准备开始批改作业。此时小杰一脸惊愕，露出了惊讶的神色。
zh.question: 小杰听到老师的话后会是什么感觉？
options: 小杰感到害怕和恐惧，因为他一直在看漫画没完成作业。
小杰很高兴，因为他完成了作业才开始看漫画，所以不用担心。
小杰感到无所谓，他并不在乎作业和老师的行为。
小杰感到好奇，他想知道别人作业做得怎么样。

en.story: Xia Xia and Xiao Dong are good friends, they are planning a backpacking trip. They invite Xiao Qiu, a new friend they just meet. One night, the three of them dine in a restaurant, discussing the details of the trip. However, Xiao Dong seems a bit distracted, he always checks the time on his phone and doesn't participate much in the discussion. Xiao Qiu finds it strange and gives Xiao Xia a questioning look. Xiao Xia sees it, smiles, and says to Xiao Dong: "There are two weeks left before departure, you are ready, right?" Xiao Dong lifts his head, looking somewhat noncommittal.
en.question: Why does Xiao Xia ask Xiao Dong if he is ready?
options: Xiao Xia notices Xiao Dong is distracted and guesses he might be unsure about the trip.
Xiao Xia just wants to confirm everyone's travel preparations.
Xiao Xia thinks Xiao Dong's preparations are interesting and wants to know what he specifically prepares.
Xiao Xia wants Xiao Dong to guide the new friend Xiao Qiu's preparations.

zh.story: 小夏和小冬是好朋友，他们正在计划一次背包旅行。他们邀请了小秋，一个刚认识的新朋友。在一个晚上，他们三个在餐厅聚餐，讨论旅行的细节。然而，小冬看起来有点心不在焉，他总是用手机查看时间，而且没怎么参与讨论。小秋觉得奇怪，向小夏投以询问的眼神。小夏看到后，笑了笑，对小冬说：“还有两周就要出发了，你准备好了吧？” 小冬抬起头，显得有些不置可否。
zh.question: 为什么小夏会问小冬是否准备好了？
options: 小夏注意到小冬心不在焉，猜测他可能对旅行不太确定。
小夏只是想确认所有人的旅行准备工作。
小夏认为小冬的准备工作会很有意思，想知道他具体准备了些什么内容。
小夏想让小冬指导新朋友小秋的准备工作。

en.story: Lin Tao, Hai Lan, and Xiao Ming are good friends, they plan to go on a vacation together during the summer vacation. Xiao Ming hopes to go to the prairie, but Lin Tao and Hai Lan, after careful planning, already choose to go to the seaside. In the lounge, Lin Tao sends a message to Hai Lan. Hai Lan receives it and nods, then looks at Xiao Ming who is next to her. Xiao Ming feels Hai Lan's gaze, raises his head and looks at her. Hai Lan smiles, makes eye contact with Lin Tao, and then says, "Xiao Ming, we decide to go to the seaside, what do you think?" Xiao Ming looks at Lin Tao and Hai Lan, hesitates for a moment, and then also nods.
en.question: Why does Hai Lan ask Xiao Ming what he thinks?
options: Hai Lan really needs Xiao Ming's advice to help plan this trip.
Hai Lan wants to draw Xiao Ming's attention to the trip, so he participates better.
Hai Lan is bored, just says something casually.
Hai Lan actually does not want to hear Xiao Ming's opinion, just wants to inform him of the confirmed result.

zh.story: 林涛、海蓝和小明是好朋友，他们计划暑假一起去旅游。小明希望去大草原，而林涛和海蓝经过精心策划，已经选定去海边的路线。在休息室，林涛给海蓝发了一条消息。海蓝收到后点了点头，然后看着旁边的小明。小明感觉到了海蓝的注视，抬头看了她一眼。海蓝笑了笑，跟林涛对视一下，然后说：“小明，我们决定去海边了，你怎么看。”小明看了看林涛和海蓝，迟疑了一下，然后也点了点头。
zh.question: 为什么海蓝要问小明怎么看？
options: 海蓝真的需要小明的建议来帮助规划这次旅行。
海蓝想引起小明对旅行的注意，让他更好地参与。
海蓝无聊，只是随口说了一句。
海蓝其实并不想听小明的意见，只是想告知他已经确定的结果。

en.story: Liu Xu, Meng Nan, and Bai Haotian are headquarters staff of the company, they are discussing the upcoming spring team activity. Bai Haotian is the person in charge of the activity, he proposes a mountain climbing activity. However, Liu Xu and Meng Nan prefer to go fishing. Liu Xu looks at Meng Nan, gives Bai Haotian a look. Meng Nan shakes his head, seems to have no information. Liu Xu cheers up, looks confident. Bai Haotian chats with other colleagues, does not pay attention to other things.
en.question: Why does Meng Nan shake his head?
options: Meng Nan indicates he does not want to participate in the spring team activity.
Meng Nan indicates he cannot see Bai Haotian's activity plan.
Meng Nan wants to tell Liu Xu that he is a bit tired.
Meng Nan indicates he is unwilling to persuade Bai Haotian to change the project.

zh.story: 柳絮，孟楠和白浩天是公司的总部员工，他们正在为即将开展的春季团队活动讨论着。白浩天是活动的负责人，他倡议举办一次爬山活动。不过，柳絮和孟楠更想去钓鱼。柳絮看着孟楠，朝着白浩天使了一个眼神。孟楠摇摇头，似乎没什么信息。柳絮打起精神，一副胸有成竹的样子。白浩天在和别的同事聊天，并未留意别的事情。
zh.question: 为什么孟楠要摇摇头？
options: 孟楠表示不想参加春季团队活动了。
孟楠表示看不到白浩天的活动计划书。
孟楠想告诉柳絮自己有点累。
孟楠表示不愿意劝说白浩天更改项目。

en.story: Zhiwei and Xiaolan are planning a short trip, they are sitting on a park bench flipping through a travel guide. Mingda, although not invited to this short trip, still stands behind them listening to their discussion. Suddenly, Zhiwei notices Mingda on the side, and gives Xiaolan a glance. Then, Xiaolan sees Zhiwei's look, shakes her head, and continues to look down at the travel guide. Mingda sees this exchange of looks, and still stands in place.
en.question: Why does Xiaolan look down at the travel guide?
options: Xiaolan finds a fun tourist spot and shares it with Zhiwei.
Xiaolan indicates that they do not need to invite Mingda to join the plan.
Xiaolan hopes Zhiwei greets Mingda on her behalf.
Xiaolan wants to find the information Zhiwei wants from the travel guide.

zh.story: 志伟和小兰正在计划一个短途旅行，他们正坐在公园的长椅上翻阅旅游指南。明达虽然没有被邀请参加这次短途旅行，但是还是在他们身后听着他们讨论。突然，志伟注意到明达在一旁，向小兰瞥了一眼。接着，小兰看到了志伟的眼神，摇了摇头，并继续低头看旅游指南。明达看到这个眼神交流，还站在原地。

options: 小兰发现了一处好玩的旅游地点，分享给志伟看。
小兰表示他们不需要邀请明达加入计划。
小兰希望志伟代替他对明达打招呼。
小兰想从旅游指南中找到志伟想要的信息。

en.story: After experiencing a long and hot highway trip, George arrives at Angela's office. Angela immediately starts to talk about some business ideas. George interrupts Angela, saying, "Ah, I experience a long and hot highway trip."

George wants Angela to provide some travel advice
George wants to say, "Can I drink something?" or "Can we rest a few minutes before we start talking about business?"
George wants to complain to Angela about his trip

zh.story: 在经历了一场漫长炎热的高速公路旅行后，George抵达了Angela的办公室。Angela立即开始谈论一些商业想法。George打断了Angela，说：“唉，我经历了一场漫长而炎热的高速公路旅行。”
zh.question: 这句话George真正想表达的含义是什么？

en.story: Marissa prepares to go to the bathroom to take a bath. Anna just finishes taking a bath. When Marissa finds the bathroom is very dirty, she calls Anna and says, "Anna, can't you find the cleaner?" Marissa continues, "Sometimes you are really lazy, Anna."

options: Anna should go to the supermarket to buy cleaner.
Anna should clean the bathroom.
Anna should hurry up and take a bath.
Anna should correct her lazy habits.

options: Anna应该去超市买清洁剂。

en.story: Jacob and his mother are about to go to the supermarket. When they arrive at the candy section, Jacob says, "Look, those candies look delicious."

Jacob is expressing his love for candy.

Jacob hopes his mother finishes shopping quickly.

Jacob希望他的母亲快速结束购物。

en.story: Paul needs to go to an interview, but he is late. He is polishing his shoes and says to his wife Julia, "I want to wear this blue shirt, but it is wrinkled."

options: Paul wants to say: "Can you iron this shirt for me?"
Paul wants to say: "I should get up earlier."
Paul wants to say: "I need to buy an iron."
Paul wants to say: "I do not like wrinkled shirts."

Paul想说：“我应该早点起床。”

en.story: Paul needs to go to an interview, but he is late. He is polishing his shoes and says to his wife Julia, "I want to wear this blue shirt, but it is wrinkled." Paul continues, "The shirt is in the basket of clothes that need ironing."

options: Paul hopes Julia irons his shirt for him.
Paul hopes Julia helps him finish polishing his shoes.
Paul hopes Julia buys him a new shirt.
Paul hopes Julia helps him sort out other clothes that need ironing.

zh.story: Paul需要去参加一场面试，但他已经迟到了。他在擦鞋子，对他的妻子Julia说：“我想穿这件蓝色的衬衫，但它很皱。” Paul继续说，“衬衫在需要熨烫的衣物篮子里。”
zh.question: Paul希望Julia做什么？
options: Paul希望Julia为他熨衬衫。
Paul希望Julia帮助他完成擦鞋的工作。
Paul希望Julia给他购买新的衬衫。
Paul希望Julia帮他整理其他需要熨烫的衣物。

en.story: Rebecca's birthday is coming soon. She says to her father, "I like animals, especially dogs."
en.question: What does Rebecca really mean when she says this?
options: Rebecca looks forward to visiting the zoo.
Rebecca hopes her father takes her to see dogs.
Rebecca hopes her father buys her a dog as a birthday gift.
Rebecca desires to understand the habits of animals, especially dogs.

zh.story: Rebecca的生日即将到来。她对父亲说：“我喜欢动物，尤其是狗。”

options: Rebecca期待去动物园参观。
Rebecca希望父亲能带她去见狗狗。
Rebecca希望父亲给她购买一只狗作为生日礼物

en.story: Rebecca's birthday is coming soon. She says to her father, "I like animals, especially dogs." Rebecca continues, "Dad, does the pet store open on my birthday?"
en.question: What does Rebecca hope her father does?
options: Rebecca hopes her father goes to the zoo with her.
Rebecca hopes her father tells her a story about dogs.
Rebecca hopes her father buys her a dog as a birthday gift.
Rebecca hopes her father helps her understand the opening hours of the pet store.

zh.story: Rebecca的生日即将到来。她对父亲说：“我喜欢动物，尤其是狗。” Rebecca继续说，“爸爸，我的生日那天宠物店会开吗？”
zh.question: Rebecca希望她的父亲做什么？
options: Rebecca希望她的父亲陪她去动物园。
Rebecca希望她的父亲给她讲述关于狗的故事。
Rebecca希望她的父亲给她购买一只狗当做生日礼物。
Rebecca希望她的父亲帮她了解宠物店的营业时间。

en.story: Beatrice and Michael move to their new home a week ago. Beatrice keeps unpacking some decorations. She says to Michael, "Michael, do you unpack those bookshelves we buy?" Beatrice continues, "If you want to make something, you should do it yourself."
en.question: What does Beatrice hope Michael does?
options: Beatrice hopes Michael designs some new furniture himself.
Beatrice hopes Michael installs the bookshelves.
Beatrice hopes Michael stops unpacking decorations.
Beatrice hopes Michael goes to the store to buy more furniture.

zh.story: Beatrice和Michael一周前搬到了他们的新家。Beatrice一直在拆包一些装饰品。她对Michael说：“Michael，你拆了那些我们购买的书架了吗？” Beatrice继续说，“如果你想做成什么东西，你应该亲自去做。”
zh.question: Beatrice希望Michael做什么？
options: Beatrice希望Michael自己设计一些新的家具。
Beatrice希望Michael安装书架。
Beatrice希望Michael不再拆包装饰品。
Beatrice希望Michael去商店购买更多的家具。

en.story: Jessica and Manny are playing with train models. Jessica holds a blue train, Manny holds a red train. Jessica says to Manny, "I do not like this train." Then, Jessica says, "Red is my favorite color."
en.question: What does Jessica hope Manny does?
options: Jessica hopes Manny exchanges trains with her.
Jessica hopes Manny paints his train blue.
Jessica hopes Manny praises her liking for the color red.
Jessica hopes Manny buys a red train model for her.

zh.story: Jessica和Manny正在玩火车模型。Jessica拿的是蓝色的火车，Manny拿的是红色的火车。Jessica对Manny说：“我不喜欢这火车。”接着，Jessica又说，“红色是我最喜欢的颜色。”
zh.question: Jessica希望Manny做什么？
options: Jessica希望Manny能和他换火车。
Jessica希望Manny能将他的火车涂成蓝色。
Jessica希望Manny能赞美她对红色的喜好。
Jessica希望Manny能购买一个红色的火车模型送给她。

en.story: Zhang Lei visits a person he is not very familiar with for some business. As they chat, the other person's mother suddenly offers Zhang Lei two Ferrero chocolates. Zhang Lei eats them in surprise. After finishing the chocolates and chatting for a while, the aunt says, "There is also a watermelon at home, do you want me to cut it for you?"
en.question: What is the real intention of the other person's mother when she says this?
options: The other person's mother wants Zhang Lei to leave as soon as possible.
The other person's mother wants Zhang Lei to eat more.
The other person's mother wants to show her generosity.
The other person's mother thinks the watermelon is very delicious and wants Zhang Lei to try it.

zh.story: 张磊因事去拜访一个不太熟的人，聊着聊着突然对方的母亲拿出两个费列罗巧克力招待张磊，张磊呆呆地就吃了；吃完接着聊了一会儿，这个阿姨又说：“家里还有个西瓜，要不也切了招待你吧。”
zh.question: 对方的母亲说这句话的时候，真正的意图是什么？
options: 对方的母亲希望张磊尽快离开。
对方的母亲希望张磊多吃一些。
对方的母亲想要展示她的慷慨大方。
对方的母亲觉得西瓜很好吃，希望张磊尝尝。

en.story: Liu Yu is on vacation, suddenly he is asked to drive the leader to the airport. He is upset about his vacation plans being ruined, so he presses the brakes harder when driving the leader. In the car, the leader suddenly says, "Xiao Liu, this is indeed Xi'an with a long history, I feel like I am back in the ancient times riding a horse carriage."
en.question: What is the real intention of the leader when he says this?
options: The leader is expressing his admiration for the history of Xi'an
The leader is complaining that Liu Yu drives too fast
The leader is expressing his love for ancient culture and long history
The leader is indirectly expressing his longing for horse carriages

zh.story: 刘雨正在休假，突然被要求开车送领导去机场，他正为休假计划的泡汤而懊恼，因此在送领导时，刹车踩得比较用力。在车上，领导突然说：“小刘啊，这不愧是有着悠久历史的西安，我这坐车有一种回到古代坐马车的感觉。”
zh.question: 领导说这句话的时候，真正的意图是什么？
options: 领导在表达对西安历史的赞美
领导在抱怨刘雨开车太急了
领导在表示他喜欢古老文化和悠久历史
领导在不直接地表达他对马车的向往

en.story: Mingkai buys a keychain when he climbs Mount Tai in college. After he starts working, his leader accidentally sees this keychain and says, "This keychain of yours is really beautiful, where do you buy it?" Mingkai then vividly tells his experience on Mount Tai. After a few days, the leader sees Mingkai's keychain again, as if he forgets, and asks again, "This keychain of yours is really beautiful, where do you buy it?"
en.question: What is the real intention of the leader when he says this?
options: The leader is very interested in Mingkai's keychain and considers buying one for himself.
The leader hopes that Mingkai gives this keychain to him.
The leader wants to test Mingkai's patience, to explore whether he is willing to explain the same thing repeatedly.
The leader reminds Mingkai that this keychain distracts him.

zh.question: 领导说这句话的时候，真正的意图是什么？
options: 领导对明凯的钥匙扣很感兴趣，考虑自己也去买一个。
领导希望明凯能将这个钥匙扣送给他。
领导想检验明凯的耐心，探究他是否愿意反复解释同一件事。
领导提醒小明这个钥匙扣使他分心了

Cao Sheng is expressing his increased need for salt.
Cao Sheng implies that the dinner Wang Hong makes does not have enough salt.
Cao Sheng is reminding them that they need to buy more ingredients.

en.story: Xiao Liu always likes to delegate unfinished work to his colleague Xiao Zhang to help complete. One day, when Xiao Liu asks Xiao Zhang for help, Xiao Zhang says, "I do not like to bother others."

zh.question: 小张说这句话时，他真正想说的是什么？
options: 小张认为自己很有能力，不需要别人帮忙。
小张不希望小刘再来麻烦他。
小张希望小刘今后能提升自己的工作能力。

en.story: Zhang Jie's leader notices that Zhang Jie always comes late to work recently. One day, the leader asks him, "Zhang Jie, do you know what time the first bus of the company arrives at the station every day?"
en.question: What is the real intention of the leader when he says this?
options: The leader is asking Zhang Jie if he knows the operating time of the company bus.
The leader is reminding Zhang Jie that he should arrive at the company earlier and should not be late anymore.
The leader wants Zhang Jie to be responsible for the upcoming bus scheduling work.
The leader is testing Zhang Jie's observation and memory.

zh.story: 张杰的领导发现张杰最近上班总是迟到，有一天领导问他说：“张杰啊，你知道每天公司的第一班公交车是几点到站的吗？”
zh.question: 当领导说出这句话的时候，他真正的意图是什么？
options: 领导在询问张杰是否清楚公司公交车的运营时间。
领导在提醒张杰应该早点到公司，不应再迟到。
领导想让张杰负责接下来的公交车调度工作。
领导在考察张杰的观察力和记忆力。

en.story: Zhang Cheng is about to graduate from university. Besides a few professional books he sends home, he plans to pack and sell all other public subject books. There are many vendors in the campus who buy old books. He randomly chooses a vendor to sell books. A bag of books weighs 40 jin for the vendor, half a yuan per jin, the vendor gives Zhang Cheng 20 yuan, and then he wants to throw the books on his car. At this time, Zhang Cheng's friend Lu Ying passes by and suddenly says, "How do I lose so much weight recently!", and then he walks away without looking back.
en.question: What does Lu Ying really mean when he says this sentence?
options: Lu Ying implies that he is losing weight recently.
Lu Ying implies that the vendor's scale might be tampered with.
Lu Ying implies that Zhang Cheng needs to keep his figure at all times.

zh.story: 章程临近大学毕业，他除了少数专业课的书寄回了家，其他公共科目的书本全部打算装袋子卖了。校园里面收废旧书本的商贩很多，他随便选了一个商贩卖书，一袋子书给商贩称了40斤，五毛一斤 ，商贩给了章程20元，然后就要将书扔在他的车子上。这时章程的朋友陆颖路过，突然说：“自己最近怎么瘦了这么多！”, 然后头也不回的走了。
zh.question: 陆颖说这句话时，真正想说的意思是什么？
options: 陆颖暗示自己最近在减肥。
陆颖暗示商贩的秤可能动了手脚。
陆颖暗示章程序时需要保持身材。

en.question: What does Xiao Zhang really mean when he says this?
options: Xiao Zhang has important things to deal with tomorrow morning
Xiao Zhang likes to get up early for morning exercise
Xiao Zhang hints that he wants to leave now
Xiao Zhang is complaining to Xiao Liu about his busy life

zh.story: 在一次同学聚会中，正在大家把酒言欢时，小张对朋友小刘说：“我明天还要早起”。
zh.question: 小张说这句话时，真正想说的意思是什么？
options: 小张明天早上有重要的事情要处理
小张喜欢早起做早晨的运动
小张暗示他现在想要离开了

en.story: Once, Cheng Wei takes his son to the mall and accompanies him to the children's playground. Suddenly, he sees a person leading a dog in. Cheng Wei asks this person, "Don't you see the sign that says no pets are allowed?" The other party appears very disdainful and has no intention of paying attention to Cheng Wei. en.question: What does the son really mean when he says this?
options: The son is mocking this person for lacking social morality.
The son is joking with his father, trying to lighten the mood.
The son likes dogs and hopes to have one.
The son wants to tell his father that dogs can't understand human language.

zh.story: 有次程伟带儿子逛商场，陪他去儿童游乐场玩，突然看到有个人牵着条狗进来，程伟就问这个人，“没看到这牌子上写着谢绝带宠物入场吗？”对方显得非常不屑，根本没打算理程伟。这个时候，一旁的儿子笑着和程伟说，“爸爸你真傻，狗又不认识字。”
zh.question: 当儿子说这句话时，他真正想说的意思是什么？
options: 儿子在讽刺这个人没有社会公德。
儿子正在和他的父亲开玩笑，试图缓和气氛。
儿子喜欢狗，希望拥有一只
儿子想告诉爸爸狗无法理解人类的语言。

en.story: In the hotel lobby, waiter Xiao Wang sees a person throwing a cigarette butt on the ground, so he walks up and says, "Sir, you drop your stuff."
en.question: What does Xiao Wang really mean when he says this?
options: Xiao Wang reminds this person that he loses an item.
Xiao Wang asks this person if the cigarette butt belongs to him.
Xiao Wang implies that this person should pick up the cigarette butt thrown on the ground.
Xiao Wang notices this person's smoking habit.

zh.story: 在酒店大堂，服务生小王看到有个人把烟头丢在了地上，于是他走上前去，说：“先生，您的东西掉了。”
zh.question: 小王说这句话时，真正想说的意思是什么？
options: 小王在提醒这个人遗失了物品。
小王在向这个人询问烟头是否属于他。
小王暗示这个人应当把丢在地上的烟头捡起来。

The manager goes on stage to ask the female audience to take off their hats, but the women ignore him after a long talk.
