options: He hopes all ladies take off their hats.
He only hopes young ladies take off their hats.
He is annoyed with the ladies wearing hats.
He is praising the elegance of older ladies.

zh.story: 19世纪，在奥地利的维也纳，妇女们喜欢戴一种高高耸起的帽子。她们进剧场看戏也不愿将帽子摘下，以致后排的观众被挡住了视线。经理上台请在座的女观众将帽子摘下来，然而说了半天妇女们也不予以理睬。最后经理又补充了一句：“那么，这样吧，年纪大一点的女士可以照顾，不必脱帽。”
zh.question: 剧场经理说这些话时，他真正想说的意思是什么？
options: 他希望所有的女士都将帽子摘下来。
他只希望年纪轻的女士将帽子摘下来。
他对戴帽子的女士感到恼火。
他在夸赞年纪大的女士的优雅。

en.story: Lao Wang works in the most powerful team in the company, and everyone in the team has strong work ability. He is a perfectionist and cannot tolerate any flaws in his work. In a work meeting, Lao Wang summarizes many detail problems that exist in the current work. Subordinate Xiao Zhang suddenly asks Lao Wang, "Lao Wang, do you like to eat fish?"
en.question: What does Xiao Zhang really mean when he says these words?
options: Xiao Zhang is asking about Lao Wang's eating habits in order to invite Old Wang to eat in the future.
Xiao Zhang wants to invite Lao Wang to eat fish to promote their relationship.
Xiao Zhang is mocking Lao Wang for being picky.
Xiao Zhang wants to change the topic to ease the tension of the work meeting.

zh.story: 老王在公司最牛的团队中工作，团队中每个人都有很强的工作能力。他是一个完美主义者，不能忍受工作中的任何一点瑕疵。一次工作会议中，老王总结了当前工作中存在的诸多细节问题。下属小张突然问老王：“老王，你喜欢吃鱼吗？”
zh.question: 小张说这些话时，他真正想说的意思是什么？
options: 小张在询问老王的饮食习惯，以便今后请老王吃饭。
小张想请老王吃鱼，以促进两人的关系。
小张在讽刺老王喜欢挑刺。
小张想改变话题，以缓解工作会议的紧张感。

en.story: When Xiao Jian is in the first year of high school, she is obsessed with novels, hiding in the quilt to read every night, and sometimes she reads during class, so her mental state in class is not very good. One day, when she is about to leave the classroom to do radio exercises, the head teacher comes to Xiao Jian and says, "Xiao Jian, are you sick recently?"
en.question: What does the head teacher really mean when she says these words?
options: The head teacher implies that Xiao Jian should pay attention to class and not always be listless.
The head teacher is inquiring about Xiao Jian's health.
The head teacher wants Xiao Jian to reduce the time she spends reading novels.
The head teacher wants Xiao Jian to rest early to maintain her health.

zh.story: 小简高一的时候沉迷于小说，天天晚上躲在被窝里看，有时候上课也看，因此上课精神状态一直不太好。有一天出教室准备做广播操的时候，班主任走到小简旁边来说了一句：“小简，你最近是不是生病了？”
zh.question: 班主任说这些话时，她真正想说的意思是什么？
options: 班主任暗示小简应当好好上课，不要总是精神萎靡。
班主任是在询问小简的健康状况。
班主任让小简减少看小说的时间。
班主任想让小简早点休息以保持健康。

en.story: On a sunny workday, everyone in the company gathers together to discuss the shopping strategy for Double Eleven enthusiastically. At this time, Minister Old Chen comes over and says, "Everyone discusses so lively!"
en.question: What does Old Chen really mean when he says these words?
options: Old Chen also wants to join this lively discussion.
Old Chen feels happy that everyone is discussing the shopping strategy together.
Old Chen hopes everyone stops discussing and returns to work.
Old Chen wants to understand the shopping strategy for Double Eleven.

zh.story: 一个阳光明媚的工作日，大伙儿在公司凑在一起热火朝天地讨论双十一购物攻略。此时，部长老陈走了过来，说：“大伙儿讨论地真热闹呢！”
zh.question: 老陈说这些话时，他真正想说的意思是什么？
options: 老陈也想参加这次热闹的讨论。
老陈感到高兴大家在一起讨论购物攻略。
老陈希望大家停止讨论，回到工作。
老陈想了解双十一的购物攻略。

en.story: After a day of work, Wang Wei comes home. His wife, Zhang Li, watches TV. Wang Wei says, "I see the lawn in the garden turns into a football field."
en.question: What does Wang Wei really mean when he says this?
options: Wang Wei likes football and wants to play football on the lawn.
Wang Wei hints that Zhang Li should clean the lawn.
Wang Wei praises their garden size as suitable for a football field
Wang Wei plans to invite his friends to play football at home.

zh.story: 经过了一天的工作，王伟回到了家。妻子张丽正在看电视。王伟说：“我看见花园的草坪已经变成了一个足球场。”
zh.question: 当王伟说这句话的时候，他真正想说的是什么？
options: 王伟喜欢足球，想在草坪上踢足球。
王伟暗示张丽应该清理草坪了。
王伟在赞美他们的花园大小适合当做足球场
王伟打算邀请他的朋友们来家里踢球。

en.story: In the evening, Lily is watching TV in the living room. Her sister, Show Show, walks to the balcony of Lily's room, points to the clothesline outside the window and says, "Hey, it probably rains tomorrow."
en.question: What does Show Show really mean when she says this?
options: Show Show wants to notify Lily that the weather might be bad tomorrow.
Show Show suggests Lily not to go out tomorrow.
Show Show hints that Lily needs to bring in the clothes that are drying.
Show Show wants Lily to know that she is looking at the clothes drying.

zh.story: 晚上，丽丽正在客厅看电视。她的妹妹秀秀走到丽丽房间的阳台，指着窗外的晾衣杆说：“哎，明天可能要下雨了。”
zh.question: 当秀秀说这句话的时候，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 秀秀想要通知丽丽，明天的天气可能会很糟糕。
秀秀建议丽丽明天不要外出。
秀秀暗示丽丽需要把晾的衣服收进来。
秀秀想让丽丽知道，她正在看晾晒的衣服。

en.story: Lucy and her friends are drinking in a bar. When her friend asks her if she wants a fourth drink, she replies, "I really like the yoga class tomorrow morning."
en.question: What does Lucy really mean when she says this?
options: Lucy looks forward to the yoga class tomorrow
Lucy wants to drink more to relax her body for the yoga class tomorrow
Lucy implies she does not want to drink anymore to affect the yoga class tomorrow
Lucy wants to tell her friends she is a yoga enthusiast

zh.story: 露西和她的朋友们正在一家酒吧里喝酒。当她的朋友问她是否想要第四杯酒的时候，她回答：“我真的非常喜欢明天早晨的瑜伽课。”
zh.question: 当露西说这句话的时候，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 露西非常期待明天的瑜伽课
露西想要多喝一杯酒以放松自己的身体，准备明天的瑜伽课
露西暗示自己不想再喝酒以影响明天的瑜伽课
露西想要告诉她的朋友她是瑜伽爱好者

en.story: In the morning, the father prepares to go to work, but the son still sleeps in bed. The father looks at his son and says, "The sun is about to shine on its butt~"
en.question: What does the father really want to say when he says this?
options: The father implies that he is going to sunbathe.
The father implies that he is surprised by the current weather.
The father implies that the son needs to prevent sunburn.
The father implies that the son should get up.

zh.story: 早晨，父亲准备出门上班，儿子却还在床上睡觉。父亲看着儿子，说：“太阳都要晒屁股啦～”
zh.question: 当父亲说这句话的时候，他真正想说的是什么？
options: 父亲暗示他要去晒太阳了。
父亲暗示他对现在的天气情况感到惊讶。
父亲在暗示儿子要防止晒伤
父亲暗示儿子应该起床了。

en.story: The little sister is playing with toys, she sees her brother playing a game on his phone. The little sister looks at her brother and says, "Brother, that game is so fun."
en.question: What does the little sister really want to say when she says this?
options: The little sister thinks her brother should play more challenging games.
The little sister is dissatisfied with her brother wasting time playing games.
The little sister wants her brother to let her play the game for a while.
The little sister thinks her brother should turn down the game music.

zh.story: 小妹妹正在玩玩具，她看到哥哥在玩手机的游戏。小妹妹看着哥哥说：“哥哥，那个游戏好好玩。”
zh.question: 当小妹妹说这句话的时候，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 小妹妹觉得哥哥应该玩更有挑战性的游戏。
小妹妹对哥哥浪费时间玩游戏感到不满。
小妹妹想让哥哥让她也玩一会儿游戏。
小妹妹觉得哥哥应该把游戏音乐调小。

en.story: In a company meeting, the manager is discussing the upcoming product launch. A new employee keeps asking questions, interrupting the manager's speech. The manager looks at him and says, "Your enthusiasm really impresses people."
en.question: What does the manager really mean when he says this?
options: The manager thinks this employee loves his job very much and appreciates it.
The manager implies that this employee should ask questions at the right time.
The manager expects all employees to show such enthusiasm.
The manager encourages the new employee to continue asking questions.

zh.story: 在公司的一个会议中，经理正在讨论即将到来的产品发布。一名新员工持续地提问，打断了经理的发言。经理看了他一眼，说：“你的热情真是让人佩服。”
zh.question: 当经理说这句话时，他真正想说的是什么？
options: 经理认为这位员工非常热爱工作，对此表示赞赏。
经理暗示这名员工应当在合适的时候提问。
经理期待所有员工都能表现出如此的热情。
经理鼓励新员工继续提问。

en.story: In the self-study class, Mingming suddenly gives a hearty laugh. Shuhua, who sits at the same table, looks over and smiles at him, saying, "Mingming, your laughter really has a unique character."
en.question: What does Shuhua really want to say when she says this?
options: Shuhua really likes Mingming's laughter and thinks it is very special.
Shuhua hints that Mingming's laughter is too loud and he should be quieter.
Shuhua praises Mingming, thinking his laughter has a unique attraction.
Shuhua finds Mingming's laughter interesting, it makes her happy.

zh.story: 在自习课上上，明明忽然发出了爽朗的笑声。同坐一桌的淑华看过去，笑着对他说：“明明，你的笑声真有特色。”
zh.question: 当淑华说这句话时，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 淑华非常喜欢明明的笑声，并认为它很特别。
淑华暗示明明他的笑声太大了，应该小声一些。
淑华在赞美明明，认为他的笑声有独特的吸引力。
淑华觉得明明的笑声很有趣，让她感到快乐。

en.story: Xiao Zhou and Sister Zhang are old friends for many years. Xiao Zhou is a doctor, he works in a hospital in Henan usually, while Sister Zhang lives in Xiamen. During the National Day holiday, Xiao Zhou comes to Xiamen for a tour. One morning, Sister Zhang asks Xiao Zhou on WeChat: "Doctor Zhou, do you have a number today? Do you see patients?"
en.question: What does Sister Zhang really mean when she says this?
options: Sister Zhang wants to ask Xiao Zhou if he can meet today
Sister Zhang wants to ask Xiao Zhou if he is treating patients in his hospital
Sister Zhang feels unwell and needs Xiao Zhou to treat her
Sister Zhang wants to ask about the smoothness of Xiao Zhou's medical career

zh.story: 小周和张姐是多年的老朋友，小周是一名医生，在平时在河南一家医院工作，张姐则生活在厦门。国庆假期，小周来到厦门旅游，一天早上，张姐微信问小周：“周医生今天有号不？坐诊不？”
zh.question: 当张姐说这句话的时候，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 张姐想问小周今天能否有空见个面
张姐想问小周是否在他的医院里为病人看病
张姐感到身体不适，需要小周给她看病
张姐想询问小周的医生职业生涯是否顺利

en.story: Anna is preparing to drive to the supermarket near her home. Her husband Tom comes out of the room, looks at the burning fire in the living room and says, "Look, this fire is really blazing."
en.question: What does Tom really want to say when he says this?
options: Tom implies that Anna should extinguish the fire in the living room before leaving.
Tom wants to express that he likes to watch the blazing flames.
Tom implies that Anna goes to the supermarket to buy some fuel for the stove.
Tom hopes that Anna makes the fire burn more vigorously.

zh.story: 安娜正在准备开车去家附近的超市购物。她的丈夫汤姆从房间走出来，看了看客厅烧着的炉火说，"看这炉火烧得真旺啊。"
zh.question: 当汤姆说这句话的时候，他真正想说的是什么？
options: 汤姆暗示安娜在出发前应当熄灭客厅的炉火。
汤姆想表达他喜欢看熊熊燃烧的火焰。
汤姆暗示安娜去超市购买一些炉子的燃料。
汤姆希望安娜把炉火烧得更旺一些。

en.story: On a summer afternoon, Nina feels very cold in the office, she says to her colleague George: "I feel like I am in the North Pole today."
en.question: What does Nina really want to say when she says this?
options: Nina hopes George goes to the North Pole with her
Nina suggests George to go out and enjoy the sun
Nina feels she might be sick
Nina hints George to turn up the air conditioning in the office

zh.story: 一个夏天的午后，妮娜在办公室感到很冷，她对她的同事乔治说：“我感觉今天到了北极一样”。
zh.question: 当妮娜说这句话的时候，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 妮娜期待乔治一起去北极旅游
妮娜在建议乔治出去享受阳光
妮娜感觉自己可能生病了
妮娜暗示乔治将办公室的空调调高一些

en.story: In the office, Xiao Lin studies the documents in his hand in front of his desk. His colleague Xiao Yang comes in, glances at the full cup of coffee in front of his desk, and then says, "Xiao Lin, your coffee is cold."
en.question: What does Xiao Yang really want to say when she says this?
options: Xiao Yang wants to tell Xiao Lin to take a break.
Xiao Yang suggests Xiao Lin to make another cup of hot coffee.
Xiao Yang questions the work efficiency of Xiao Lin.
Xiao Yang hopes Xiao Lin drinks more water and less coffee.

zh.story: 在办公室，小林在办公桌前苦苦研读手里的文件。他的同事小杨进来，看了一眼他的桌前满杯的咖啡，然后说：“小林，你的咖啡已经冷掉了。”
zh.question: 当小杨说这句话的时候，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 小杨想告诉小林需要休息一下。
小杨建议小林再煮一杯热咖啡。
小杨在质疑小林的工作效率。
小杨希望小林能多喝水，少喝咖啡。

en.story: Xiaoyu and Xiaohua are a couple. One day, Xiaoyu puts their IDs together, saying it is to see who looks better, Xiaohua says, "Doesn't the comparison require the same lighting, the same photographer, and the same conditions to reach a correct conclusion? Shall we go take ID photos together another day?"
en.question: What does Xiaohua really want to say when he says this?
options: Xiaohua hopes to hire a new photographer to retake his and Xiaoyu's ID photos.
Xiaohua is not satisfied with his ID photo and hopes to retake it.
Xiaohua suggests that they go to register for marriage.
Xiaohua hopes that he and Xiaoyu buy a set of professional photography equipment.

zh.story: 小雨和小华是一对恋人。一天，小雨将两人身份证放一起，说是比谁更好看，小华说：“比对不是得同样的灯光，同样的摄影师，同等条件下才能得出正确的结论吗？改天我们一起去拍证件照？”
zh.question: 当小华说这句话的时候，他真正想说的是什么？
options: 小华希望换一个摄影师重新拍摄他和小雨的证件照。
小华觉得自己的证件照拍摄的不满意，希望重新拍摄。
小华建议两人去办理结婚登记。
小华希望他和小雨购买一套专业的摄影设备。

en.story: Ouyang is a high school student, his seat is in the last row of the class. One day, his teacher, Mr. Chen, asks him in class, "Ouyang, how is the scenery outside the window?"
en.question: What does Mr. Chen really want to say when he says this?
options: Mr. Chen worries that Ouyang, sitting in the last row, may not see the blackboard clearly.
Mr. Chen reminds Ouyang that he should not look around during class.
Mr. Chen wants to know what the scenery outside the window looks like.
Mr. Chen hopes that Ouyang appreciates the scenery outside the window, feeling the beauty of nature.

zh.story: 欧阳是个高中生，他的坐位在班上的最后一排。一天，他的老师陈老师在课上问他：“欧阳，窗外的风景怎么样呢？”
zh.question: 当陈老师说这句话时，他真正想说的是什么？
options: 陈老师担心欧阳坐在最后一排，可能看不清黑板。
陈老师在提醒欧阳上课不应该东张西望。
陈老师想知道窗外的风景是什么样子。
陈老师希望欧阳能够欣赏窗外的风景，感受大自然的美好。

en.story: Xiao Zhang buys oranges at a street stall, he asks the boss, "Are the oranges sour?"\nThe boss says, "They are very sweet."\nA big sister who buys oranges next to him says, "They are too sweet and hurt the teeth, a little sour is the best. I like this kind the most."
en.question: What does she really want to say when the big sister says this?
options: She wants to express that she likes to eat oranges with a bit of sourness.
She wants to tell Xiao Zhang that the oranges in this place are very sweet.
She praises the stall owner's oranges, expressing her love for this taste.
She implies that the oranges Xiao Zhang buys are sour.

zh.story:
小张在街边小摊上买橘子，他问老板：“橘子酸不？”
老板说：“甜得很”
旁边一个买橘子的大姐说：：“太甜了齁牙，略微带点酸的最好。我最喜欢这种。”
zh.question: 当大姐说这句话时，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 她想表达她自己最喜欢吃带点酸的橘子。
她想告诉小张这个地方的橘子非常甜。
她在赞美摊主的橘子，表示对这种味道的喜爱。
她暗示小张买的橘子是酸的。

en.story: Linda holds her pet dog and enters the house on a winter night, she says to her husband Bob: "Ah, the dog's fur is almost freezing."
en.question: What does Linda really mean when she says this?
options: Linda implies to Bob that they should raise the temperature inside the house.
Linda implies to Bob that the pet dog's fur needs cleaning.
Linda implies to Bob that he needs to buy a new pet dog coat.
Linda implies to Bob that he should take the dog to the vet for a check-up.

zh.story: 琳达在冬夜抱着宠物狗进了家，她对丈夫鲍勃说：“呀，狗狗的毛皮都快结冰了。”
zh.question: 当琳达说这句话时，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 琳达暗示鲍勃他们应该提高屋内的温度。
琳达暗示鲍勃宠物狗的皮毛需要清理。
琳达暗示鲍勃需要买一件新的宠物狗外套。
琳达暗示鲍勃应该带狗狗去兽医那里检查。

en.story: Wang Yuan breaks up with his girlfriend for a year now. After that, Wang Yuan experiences changes and faces unemployment, so he starts to install the Didi taxi app to run online car-hailing. One day, he picks up a female passenger, who turns out to be his ex-girlfriend. Along the way, the two are silent, the ex-girlfriend's expression struggles, as if she is making some mental preparation. After arriving at the destination, she quietly asks Wang Yuan: "Can we go back?"
en.question: When the current girlfriend says this sentence, what does she really want to say?
options: She wants to ask Wang Yuan if he can take her home
She asks Wang Yuan if the two can be boyfriend and girlfriend again
She is getting Wang Yuan's opinion on running Didi as a career choice
She implies that she takes the wrong car, asking Wang Yuan if he can take her back to the place where she hails the taxi

zh.story: 王原和女友分手已经一年了。之后王原历经变故，遭遇失业，他就开始装上滴滴打车软件跑网约车。有一天，他拉上一位女乘客，竟然是前女友。一路上两人相对无语，前女友的表情很挣扎，仿佛在做什么心理准备。到达目的地后，她轻声问王原：“我们还能回去吗？”
zh.question: 当前女友说这句话时，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 她想问王原是否可以把她送回家
她询问王原两人能否做回男女朋友关系
她在获取王原对于跑滴滴作为职业选择的看法
她暗示自己打错了车，询问王源能否将其送回打车的地方

en.story: Wang Yuan breaks up with his girlfriend for a year already. After that, Wang Yuan experiences changes and faces unemployment, so he starts to install the Didi taxi app to run online car-hailing. One day, he picks up a female passenger, who turns out to be his ex-girlfriend. Along the way, the two are silent, the ex-girlfriend's expression struggles, as if she is making some mental preparation. After arriving at the destination, she quietly asks Wang Yuan: "Can we go back?" Wang Yuan lights a cigarette, struggles for a long time and says: "Go back? Going back costs an extra twenty!"
en.question: When Wang Yuan says this sentence, what does he really want to say?
options: He wants to express his willingness to reconcile with his ex-girlfriend, but the premise is to increase the fee.
He expresses his willingness to take his ex-girlfriend back to the place where he picks her up, the premise is to increase the fee
He expresses the hope that his ex-girlfriend understands his current economic difficulties.
He indicates his refusal to the ex-girlfriend's reconciliation request.

zh.story: 王原和女友分手已经一年了。之后王原历经变故，遭遇失业，他就开始装上滴滴打车软件跑网约车。有一天，他拉上一位女乘客，竟然是前女友。一路上两人相对无语，前女友的表情很挣扎，仿佛在做什么心理准备。到达目的地后，她轻声问王原：“我们还能回去吗？”王原点了一支烟，纠结了半天说：“回去？回去得加二十！”
zh.question: 当王原说这句话时，他真正想说的是什么？
options: 他想表明自己愿意与前女友复合，但前提是增加费用。
他表达自己愿意将前女友送回打车的地方，前提是增加费用
他表达了希望前女友理解他目前经济状况的困难。
他表明自己拒绝前女友复合的请求。

en.story: During the senior year, Li Chen often arrives late in the morning, and he is late for several days in a row. The head teacher gets angry, blocks Li Chen in the corridor for a lecture, then takes Li Chen to the office, and says to him: "You like to sleep so much, then you sleep here peacefully! You do not attend today's class!" Then he slams the door and leaves.
en.question: What does the head teacher really mean when he says this?
options: The head teacher hopes that Li Chen can attend class alone in the office
The head teacher encourages Li Chen to give up his studies and rest well
The head teacher implies that Li Chen should attend class on time and not be late
The head teacher is disappointed in Li Chen and does not want him to attend class anymore

zh.story: 高三那会儿，李晨早上经常迟到，连续几天都迟到。班主任生气了，把李晨堵在走廊一通教育，然后拉着李晨去了办公室，对他说：“你这么喜欢睡，那你就在这里安安心心地睡觉吧！今天的课也不要上了！” 然后摔门而出。
zh.question: 当班主任说这句话时，他真正想说的是什么？
options: 班主任希望李晨可以单独在办公室上课
班主任鼓励李晨放弃学业，好好休息
班主任暗示李晨要按时上课，不要迟到
班主任对李晨失望，不希望他再来上课

en.story: A science male student goes to a classroom to study every night, always sitting behind a girl he does not know. Gradually, the boy falls in love with the girl, but he never has the courage to confess. When his roommates know, they all encourage him. One night, the boy finally gathers the courage, writes a love letter, and gives it to the girl.\nThe girl looks at it for a while, packs up her study tools, turns around and says to the boy: I want to go back, what about you?
en.question: What does she really want to say when the girl says this sentence?
options: She indicates that she wants to go home and asks if the boy also wants to go home.
She hopes the boy understands that she needs to be alone.
She does not want to be with the boy.
She implies that she agrees with the boy's confession.

zh.story:
一个理科男生每晚都去一个教室自习，每次都坐在一个不认识的女生后面。渐渐地，男生喜欢上了女生，但一直没有勇气表白。舍友们知道后，全都鼓励他。一天晚上，男生终于鼓足了勇气，写了一封表白信，递到女生的手里。
女生看了一会儿之后，收拾学习用具，转身对男生说：我想回去了，你呢？
zh.question: 当女生说出这句话时，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 她表明自己要回家了，询问男生是否也要回家。
她希望男生可以明白她需要独处。
她不想和男生在一起。
她暗示自己同意了男生的表白。

en.story: Zhang Tao and Wang Hua are playing billiards in the company lounge. After a round of poor team cooperation, Wang Hua comments, "It seems our teammates forget to drink coffee today."
en.question: What does Wang Hua really mean when he says this?
options: He implies that teammates need to increase their focus.
He thinks their teammates need to actually go drink coffee.
He thinks his teammate is a coffee lover.
He implies that he wants to treat his teammates to coffee.

zh.story: 张涛和王华正在公司休息室打台球，王华在一轮糟糕的队友配合后，评论道：“看来我们的队友们今天忘记喝咖啡了。”
zh.question: 当王华说这句话时，他真正想说的是什么？
options: 他暗示队友们需要提升专注度。
他认为他们的队友需要真正去喝咖啡。
他认为他的队友是咖啡爱好者。
他暗示自己要请队友喝咖啡

en.story: Li Yan takes her son to play in the park, and sees that her son throws the fruit peel on the grass. She says to him: "Oh my, look how lonely that trash can over there is."
en.question: What does Li Yan really mean when she says this?
options: She tells the story of the trash can.
She praises the design of the trash can.
She hints that the park cleaners do not do their job.
She hints that her son should throw the fruit peel into the trash can.

zh.story: 李燕带儿子在公园玩耍，看到他的儿子把果皮丢在了草地上，她对他说：“天呐，看那边的垃圾桶先生也太寂寞了。”
zh.question: 当李燕说这句话时，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 她在讲述垃圾桶的故事。
她在赞美垃圾桶的设计。
她在暗示公园的清洁工人不尽职。
她在暗示儿子应当把果皮扔进垃圾桶。

en.story: Zhang Rong and Xiao Gang are a couple, they are in a furniture store. Seeing a beautiful bed, Zhang Rong says to Xiao Gang: "I definitely sleep well on this bed."
en.question: What does Zhang Rong really want to say when she says this?
options: She thinks Xiao Gang looks very tired and needs a good rest.
She can read quietly on this bed.
She hints to Xiao Gang that she wants to buy this bed.
She is imagining herself sleeping on this bed.

zh.story: 张蓉和小刚是一对情侣，他们正在一家卖家具的商店里。看到一个漂亮的床，张蓉对小刚说：“在这张床上一定会睡得很香。”
zh.question: 当张蓉说这句话时，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 她觉得小刚看上去很累，需要好好休息。
她可以在这张床上安静地看书。
她暗示小刚自己想买下这张床。
她正在想象自己在这张床上睡觉的样子。

en.story: Xiao Yang is the person in charge of the dance club. One day, she looks at the club's dance costumes and says, "These dance costumes make people feel heartbroken."
en.question: What does Xiao Yang really mean when she says this?
options: She thinks the color of the dance costumes is not good.
She believes someone secretly wears the club's dance costumes.
She implies that the dance costumes are old and need to buy new ones.
She complains too much about the members of the dance club.

zh.story: 小杨是舞蹈社团的负责人，一天，她看着社团的舞蹈服说：“这些舞蹈服看了令人心疼。”
zh.question: 当小杨说这句话时，她真正想说的是什么？
options: 她觉得舞蹈服颜色不好看。
她认为有人在偷偷穿社团的舞蹈服。
她暗示舞蹈服已经旧了，需要购买新的。
她对舞蹈社团的成员们抱怨太多。

en.story: Xiao Yang's company holds a weekly meeting every Wednesday. On a certain Monday, the leader takes Xiao Wang to meet with client Director Zhang. The two of them chat happily, but they only talk about some irrelevant topics because there are disagreements on the main issues. As it approaches mealtime, the following conversation occurs: Leader: "Director Zhang, it is almost mealtime, do you have time? I want to invite you to have a meal." Then the leader turns around, winks, and says to Xiao Yang: "Xiao Yang, do we have a meeting at the unit tonight?"
en.question: What is the leader's purpose when he asks Xiao Yang this question?
options: The leader wants to ask Xiao Yang about the meeting time to arrange a meal with the client.
The leader hopes Xiao Yang answers that there is a meeting tonight, so he can use this as an excuse to end the meeting.
The leader wants to understand Xiao Yang's preparation for the weekly meeting.
The leader wants to ask if Xiao Yang is willing to skip the meeting and join them for dinner.

zh.story: 小杨所在的公司周三有周例会。某周一，领导带着小王去会见客户张局，两人一直相谈甚欢，但谈的都是一些无关痛痒的话题，因为正事存在观点分歧。眼看着将近饭点，出现了下面几句对话： 领导：“张局，快到饭点了，看您有时间吗？想约您吃个饭？” 然后领导转过身，边眨眼睛，边对小杨说：“小杨，咱们晚上单位还有会议吗？”
zh.question: 当领导问小杨这个问题的时候，他的目的是什么？
options: 领导想向小杨询问会议时间，以安排和客户的饭局。
领导希望小杨回答今晚有会议，以此借口结束会面。
领导想了解小杨对周例会的准备情况。
领导希望询问小杨愿不愿不参加会议，而陪他们吃饭。

en.story: Xiao Wang and the girl he meets online, Xiao Lan, arrange to meet at a hotel. At the front desk, Xiao Lan does not want to show her ID for registration. The front desk staff asks, "Are you one or two? If two, the gentleman needs to show both IDs." Xiao Wang turns his head and looks at Xiao Lan, she slowly walks to the edge of the sofa and sits down, still showing no intention of showing her ID. So Xiao Wang turns his head and asks, "Two, what to do?" At this time, the front desk staff asks again, "Are you checking in for one or two?"
en.question: What is his purpose when the staff asks this question?
options: He does not hear Xiao Wang's previous answer clearly and needs to confirm again.
He is re-verifying Xiao Wang's accommodation needs.
He hints that Xiao Wang can answer one person checks in, so only one person's ID is needed.
He hints that if they do not show both IDs, they cannot stay together.

zh.story: 小汪和网络上认识的女生小兰的见面约在了酒店。在前台，小兰不愿意出示身份证登记。 前台工作人员问：“您是一位还是两位？两位的话需要出示双方身份证的先生。” 小汪回头看着小兰，她慢慢走到沙发边上坐下仍然没有出示身份证的意思。于是小汪转过头问：“两位，那怎么办？” 此时前台工作人员又问：“您是一位入住还是两位呢？”
zh.question: 当工作人员提出这个问题的时候，他的目的是什么？
options: 他没有听清楚小汪之前的回答，要再进行确认。
他正在重新核实小汪的住宿需求。
他暗示小汪可回答一位入住，这样只需要用一个人的身份证。
他暗示不出示两人身份证就不可以一起住宿。

en.story: Fitness coach Zhang Jiali drives without a seatbelt one time and a traffic cop catches her. The traffic cop comes over and asks Zhang Jiali, "Why don't you wear a seatbelt? Are you pregnant?"
en.question: What is the real intention of the traffic cop when he asks this question?
options: The traffic cop wants to know about Zhang Jiali's personal life
The traffic cop wants to confirm if Zhang Jiali is pregnant, because pregnant people do not need to wear seatbelts
The traffic cop hopes Zhang Jiali goes to the hospital for a pregnancy test
The traffic cop implies that Zhang Jiali can say she is pregnant to avoid a fine

zh.story: 健身教练张佳丽有一次开车没带安全带被交警拍到了。交警走过来问张佳丽：“为什么没系安全带？是不是怀孕了？”
zh.question: 当交警问这个问题时，他真正的意图是什么？
options: 交警想要了解张佳丽的个人生活
交警想确认张佳丽是否怀孕了，因为怀孕的人不用系安全带
交警希望张佳丽去医院做孕检
交警暗示张佳丽可以回答自己怀孕了，以避免罚款

en.story: At a company annual meeting, Li Na and Zhang Yu are colleagues. A talent show for employees takes place at the annual meeting, and Li Na sings a bit out of tune. When Li Na performs on stage, Zhang Yu watches her sing enthusiastically and can't help but say, "Secretary Li, your singing is really good, the boss should promote you to be a singer, right?"
en.question: Why does Zhang Yu say this?
options: Zhang Yu wants to say that Li Na's singing performance at the annual meeting is very bad.
Zhang Yu mocks Li Na because he has bad intentions towards Li Na.
Zhang Yu wants to mock Li Na for her bad singing.
Zhang Yu wants to mock Li Na for wanting to get promoted through connections.

zh.story: 在一次公司年会上，李娜和张宇是同事关系。年会上进行了一场员工才艺展示，李娜是唱的有点跑调。当李娜上台演唱时，张宇看着她演唱得起劲，忍不住调侃道：“老板请你当秘书可惜了，怎么没请你当歌手？”
zh.question: 张宇为什么这么说？
options: 张宇是想说李娜在年会上的唱歌表现非常不好。
张宇讽刺李娜是因为他对李娜有不良企图。
张宇是想讽刺李娜唱歌不好听。
张宇是想讽刺李娜想靠关系晋升。

en.story: Xiao Li does his math homework in his room. His mom tells him to go to his aunt's house tonight. Xiao Li is busy doing his homework, only thinking about finishing it quickly, and casually agrees. At dinner, his dad asks, "Are we going to your aunt's house tonight?" Xiao Li says, "No, we don't have plans."
en.question: Why does Xiao Li say this?
options: Xiao Li deliberately lies because he does not want to go to his aunt's house.
Xiao Li forgets the plan his mother tells him because he focuses on his math homework.
Xiao Li deliberately lies because he wants to continue doing homework.
Xiao Li is busy thinking about eating and does not hear his mother's plan for tonight.

zh.story: 小李在房间里做数学作业。他妈妈告诉他晚上去姑姑家。 小李忙着做作业，只想着快写完，随口应下了。 晚饭时，爸爸问：“今晚去姑姑家吗？”小李说：“没有，我们没计划。”
zh.question: 小李为什么这么说？
options: 小李故意撒谎，因为他不想去姑姑家。
小李忘记了妈妈告诉他的计划，因为他专注于数学作业。
小李故意撒谎，因为他想继续做作业。
小李忙着想吃饭没听妈妈说今晚的计划。

en.story: Xiaoling promises her mother to help her clean up the room. Then, she receives a call from a friend and gets invited to a party. Xiaoling happily leaves the house, completely forgetting her mother's request. When she comes home at night, her mother asks: "Do you clean up the room?" Xiaoling recalls that she seems to clean up and says: "Of course, I tidy up very neatly."
en.question: Is what Xiaoling says true?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 小玲答应妈妈帮她收拾房间。然后，她接到朋友的电话，被邀请参加一个聚会。小玲高兴地走出家门，完全忘记了妈妈的嘱托。晚上回家时，妈妈问：“房间收拾好了吗？”小玲回忆自己好像是收拾了说：“当然，我已经收拾得很整齐了。”
zh.question: 小玲说的是真的吗？
options: 是
不是

en.story: Xiao Ming promised his mom to help tidy up the desk at home, but he left in a hurry and forgot that he hadn't finished tidying up completely. When he returns home, his mom asks, "Is the desk tidied up?" Xiao Ming thinks for a moment and says, "It's tidied up."
en.question: Why does Xiao Ming say this?
options: Xiao Ming intentionally lies because he does not want his mother to get angry.
Xiao Ming forgets that he tidies up but does not completely tidy up the desk.
Xiao Ming intentionally lies because he wants to continue doing what he likes.
Xiao Ming thinks he completely tidies up the desk because he usually does.

zh.story: 小明答应妈妈要在家里帮忙整理书桌，但他出门时匆忙忘记了自己没完全收拾完。回家后，妈妈问：“书桌整理好了吗？”小明想了想说：“整理好了。
zh.question: 小明为什么这么说？
options: 小明故意撒谎，因为他不想让妈妈生气。
小明忘记了他虽然整理了但没有整理完书桌。
小明故意撒谎，因为他想继续做他喜欢的事情。
小明认为自己已经完全整理好了书桌，因为他通常都完成了。

en.story: Li Ming and Xiao Hong are preparing to participate in the school's evening party, but Li Ming has forgotten the dance steps for his performance. When Xiao Hong asks him, "How do we perform?" Li Ming tries hard to remember and quickly answers, "Of course, it's left turn, right turn, and then jump."
en.question: Is what Li Ming says true?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 李明和小红一起准备参加学校的晚会，但李明忘记了自己的舞蹈表演的舞步。当小红问他：“我们的表演怎么走？” 李明努力回忆了迅速回答：“当然是左转，右转，然后跳起来。”
zh.question: 李明这么回答是真的么？
options: 是
不是

en.story: Li Ming and Xiao Hong are preparing to participate in the school's evening party, but Li Ming has forgotten the dance steps for his performance. When Xiao Hong asks him, "How do we perform?" Li Ming tries hard to remember and quickly answers, "Of course, it's left turn, right turn, and then jump."
en.question: Why does Li Ming answer like this?
options: Li Ming does not want to tell Xiao Hong the specific steps of the dance.
Li Ming forgets the dance steps of his dance performance.
Li Ming intentionally provides incorrect information, wanting the performance to go wrong.
Li Ming indeed thinks that turning left, turning right, jumping up are the correct performance steps.

zh.story: 李明和小红一起准备参加学校的晚会，但李明忘记了自己的舞蹈表演的舞步。当小红问他：“我们的表演怎么走？” 李明努力回忆了迅速回答：“当然是左转，右转，然后跳起来。”
zh.question: 为什么李明这么回答？
options: 李明不愿意告诉小红舞蹈的具体步骤。
李明忘记了自己的舞蹈表演的舞步。
李明故意提供错误的信息，想让表演出现差错。
李明确实认为左转、右转、跳起来是正确的表演步骤。

en.story: Zhang Ming gets a promotion at work, but his good friend Zhao Lei does not. They have a conflict recently, but Zhang Ming still goes to Zhao Lei. Zhang Ming says to Zhao Lei: "I know you work hard!". After going home, Zhang Ming says to his sister: "I am really sad, but I finally get what I want"
en.question: Why is Zhang Ming both happy and sad?
options: He is happy that he gets promoted, but sad that Zhao Lei does not.
He is happy that Zhao Lei does not get promoted, so he can get the promotion alone.
He is sad that he gets promoted, because he does not like the extra work responsibility.
He is happy that he gets promoted, but sad that he has a conflict with Zhao Lei.

zh.story: 张明在工作中获得晋升，但他的好朋友赵雷没有。张明去找赵雷了。张明对赵雷说：“我知道你很努力了！”。回家后张明对姐姐说：“ 我真的很难过，但我终于如愿了”
zh.question: 张明为什么既高兴又难过？
options: 他高兴自己晋升，但难过赵雷没晋升。
他高兴赵雷没晋升，这样他才能独自获得晋升。
他难过自己晋升，因为他不喜欢额外的工作责任。
他高兴自己晋升，但难过他和赵雷闹矛盾了。

en.story: Li Xiao and Wang Qiang team up to participate in an academic competition, their team wins the first place, Wang Qiang receives the best paper award. Li Xiao says to Wang Qiang: "I am really so happy, congratulations my friend!" In the evening, when she returns home, Li Xiao says to her father: "I am very sad."
en.question: Is what Li Xiao says to her father true?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 李晓和王强一起组队参加了一次学术竞赛，他们队赢得了第一名，王强获得了最佳论文奖。李晓对王强说：“我真的太高兴了，祝贺你我的朋友！” 晚上回到家，李晓对她爸爸说：“我很难过。”
zh.question: 李晓对她爸爸说的话是真的吗？
options: 是
否

en.story: In a small town, Wang Li and Wang Ben are a pair of close siblings. One day, Wang Ben, because of his outstanding musical talent, gets accepted by a well-known music academy, becoming the first person in their family to get accepted by a university, while Wang Li does not receive an admission notice. Wang Li says during the celebration, "I am really happy for you!" But when she is alone, she sighs deeply.
en.question: Is what Wang Li says to Wang Ben true?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 在一座小镇上，王莉和王本是一对亲密无间的兄妹。一天，王本因为出色的音乐才华被一家知名音乐学院录取，成为了他们家族中第一个被大学录取的人，而王莉并没有拿到录取通知书。王莉在庆祝时说：“真的很为你高兴！”但当她独自一人时，她深深叹了口气。
zh.question: 王莉对王本说的是真的么？
options: 是
否

en.story: Wang Zhi and Liu Mei are colleagues, and they worked together on an urgent project. After completing the project, Wang Zhi is very happy and says to Liu Mei, "We really did a great job, and I am proud." The leader publicly praised the project team and promoted and gave a raise to Liu Mei. However, Wang Zhi's expression becomes somewhat disheartened.
en.question: Is Wang Zhi really proud?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 王志和刘梅是同事，他们一同参与了一项紧急项目。项目完成后，王志非常开心和刘梅说：“我们真的做得很好，我很骄傲。” 领导当众表扬了项目组，并给刘梅升职加薪了。王志的表情却变得有些沮丧。
zh.question: 王志是真的很骄傲么？
options: 是
否

en.story: Lily and Mark are a young couple, and they have just moved into a new house they bought with a loan. Mark is excited about the new home and says, "This will be the start of our new life!" However, when Lily sees Mark sitting quietly alone in the room, he says to her, "I've actually been worrying if we made the right decision all along."
en.question: Why does Mark express both excitement and worry?
options: Mark is excited about the start of new life, but worries about family finances.
Mark is excited about moving into a new home, but worries about job prospects.
Mark is excited about life changes, but worries about social issues.
Mark is excited about new home life, but worries about emotional stability.

zh.story: 莉莉和马克是一对年轻夫妻，他们刚刚搬进了新贷款买的房子。马克在新家中充满期待，说：“这将是我们新生活的开始！”然而，当莉莉看到马克一个人在房间里默默地坐着时，他对她说：“我其实一直在担心我们是否做出了正确的决定。
zh.question: 为什么马克表达了既兴奋又担忧的情绪？
options: 马克兴奋新生活开始，但担忧家庭财务。
马克兴奋搬进新家，但担忧工作前景。
马克兴奋生活变化，但担忧社交问题。
马克兴奋新家生活，但担忧感情稳定。

en.story: Li Lei really likes to play basketball, but his skills are not very good. Li Lei's friends often invite him to play basketball after school. Lei's sister always mocks his basketball skills. He is now in his senior year of high school and his coursework is heavy. Today is the weekend, Li Lei's friend invites him to play basketball. When Lei's sister asks him, "Do you go to play basketball today?" Li Lei answers, "No."
en.question: Why does Li Lei want to play basketball, but he says no?
options: Because he thinks basketball is not interesting.
Because he is afraid of being mocked by his friends.
Because he does not want his sister to mock him anymore.
Because he is in his senior year of high school and his coursework is heavy, he does not want to affect his studies by playing basketball.

zh.story: 李雷非常喜欢打篮球，但是技术不太好。 李雷的朋友经常在放学后邀请他去打篮球。雷的姐姐总是嘲笑他打篮球的技术。他现在高三了课业慎重。 今天周末，李雷的朋友邀请他一起去打篮球。当雷的姐姐问他：“你今天去打篮球吗？”李雷回答：“不去。”
zh.question: 为什么李雷明明想去打篮球，却说不去？
options: 因为他觉得篮球没意思。
因为他害怕被朋友嘲笑。
因为他不想让姐姐再嘲笑他。
因为他高三课业太重，不想因为打篮球影响学习。

en.story: Xiaohua's sister recently buys a new computer, she worries that others damage the computer, she never allows others to use it.\nToday, a new game comes out, Xiaohua wants to play the game on the new computer. When Xiaohua's friend asks him if he wants to play the new game, Xiaohua says he does not.
en.question: Is what Xiaohua says to his friend true?
options: Yes
No

zh.story:
小华的姐姐最近买了一台新电脑，她担心旁人给电脑弄坏了，从来不允许他人使用。
今天上了一个新游戏，小华想在新电脑上玩游戏。当小华的朋友问他是否想玩新游戏，小华说不想。
zh.question: 小华对朋友说的话是真的吗？
options: 是
否

en.story: Xiaohua's sister recently buys a new computer, she worries that others damage the computer, she never allows others to use it.\nToday, a new game comes out, Xiaohua wants to play the game on the new computer. When Xiaohua's friend asks him if he wants to play the new game, Xiaohua says he does not.
en.question: Why does Xiaohua want to play the new game, but he says he does not?
options: Because he does not want his friends to know he cannot play the new game.
Because he fears that his sister gets angry if he uses her new computer to play games.
Because he actually does not know how to play computer games very well.
Because she does not have the time and equipment to play the new game.

zh.story:
小华的姐姐最近买了一台新电脑，她担心旁人给电脑弄坏了，从来不允许他人使用。
今天上了一个新游戏，小华想在新电脑上玩游戏。当小华的朋友问他是否想玩新游戏，小华说不想。
zh.question: 为什么小华想玩新游戏，却说他不想？
options: 因为他不想让朋友知道他没法玩新游戏。
因为他害怕用了姐姐的新电脑玩游戏她生气。
因为他实际上不太会玩电脑游戏。
因为她没有玩新游戏的时间和设备。

en.story: Xiao Hong always wants to go to the movies with her boyfriend. But she thinks the movie tickets are too expensive and she is reluctant to buy them. Her friend Xiao Zhang gives her two movie tickets, which are for a horror movie. Xiao Hong's sister asks her if she wants to go to the movies together, Xiao Hong replies "I am not sure if I have time, so I am not going".
en.question: Does Xiao Hong really not want to go to the movies?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 小红一直想和男友一起去看的电影。但是她觉得电影票太贵了一直没舍得买。她的朋友小张送个她了两张电影票，是恐怖电影。 小红的姐姐问她否要一起去看电影，小红回答“ 我不一定有时间，就不去了”。
zh.question: 小红真的不想去看电影吗？
options: 是
否

en.story: Xiaoli's father is a chef, he often cooks delicious dishes at home. Xiaoli really likes to eat the braised pork that her father makes. When her father makes braised pork, he likes to put a lot of oil and fry the meat first, the fried meat smells very good. Making braised pork takes a lot of time. One night, when her father asks Xiaoli if she wants to eat braised pork, she says "I do not want to eat."
en.question: Why does Xiaoli say she doesn't want to eat braised pork?
options: Because she wants to lose weight.
Because she thinks braised pork is not healthy.
Because she eats too many snacks, she is not hungry anymore.
Because she doesn't want to bother her father to spend too much time.

zh.story: 小丽的爸爸是一名厨师，经常在家做美味的菜。小丽非常喜欢吃爸爸做的红烧肉，爸爸做红烧肉的时候喜欢放很多油先炸一遍肉，炸过的肉特别香。 做红烧肉需要花费很多时间。 一天晚上，爸爸问小丽是否想吃红烧肉时，她说“不想吃”。
zh.question: 为什么小丽会说不想吃红烧肉呢？
options: 因为她想减肥。
因为她觉得红烧肉不健康。
因为她吃太多零食，已经不饿了。
因为她不想麻烦爸爸花费太多时间。

en.story: Xiao Ming is a big liar. Xiao Ming's brother, Xiao Yang, secretly knows that Xiao Ming is a big liar, but Xiao Ming thinks he can escape punishment for anything! Yesterday, Xiao Ming steals Xiao Yang's ping pong paddle, Xiao Yang knows where Xiao Ming hides it, but he cannot find it. He is very angry. So he finds Xiao Ming and says: "Where is my paddle? You must hide it in the cabinet or under the bed, because I search everywhere else. Where is it? In the cabinet or under the bed?" Xiao Ming tells him the paddle is under the bed.
en.question: Does Xiao Ming tell Xiao Yang the truth?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 小明是个大骗子。 小明的哥哥小阳暗地里知道小明是个大骗子,但小明却认为自己什么都能逃脱惩罚！昨天,小明偷了小阳的乒乓球拍,小阳知道小明把它藏在什么地方了,但他找不到。他非常生气。 于是他找到小明说："我的球拍呢？ 你一定是把它藏在柜子里或者床底下了,因为我已经找遍了其他地方。在哪儿呢？ 柜子里还是床底下？"小明告诉他球拍在床底下。
zh.question: 小明告诉小阳的是真的吗？
options: 是
否

en.story: Zhao Jun is a young entrepreneur, and his company has recently encountered some financial difficulties. His competitor has announced that their company is about to launch a new product. In order to prevent investors from losing confidence, he has posted a series of false news on social media about his company soon receiving a large investment.
en.question: Is the news released by Zhao Jun true?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 赵军是一个年轻的企业家，他的公司最近遇到了一些财务困难。他竞争对手发布消息说自己公司有新产品即将发售。为了不让投资者失去信心，他在社交媒体上发布了一系列关于公司即将获得大型投资的假消息。
zh.question: 赵军发布的消息是真的么？
options: 是
否

en.story: Li Ming and Zhao Li are colleagues in the same team. They both desire an important promotion opportunity. To make the leader believe they are the most suitable candidates, Li Ming exaggerates his past achievements during the meeting. After seeing this, Zhao Li intentionally encourages Li Ming to submit a promotion application during the meeting but secretly gathers evidence of Li Ming's exaggerations.
en.question: Is Zhao Li really encouraging Li Ming?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 李明和赵丽是同一团队里的同事，他们都渴望获得一个重要的晋升机会。为了让领导认为自己是最合适的人选，李明在会议上夸大其辞地陈述了自己的过去成就。赵丽看到这一情况后，她在开会的时候故意鼓励李明提交升职申请，但是背地里在搜集李明夸大其词的证据。
zh.question: 赵丽是真的想鼓励李明么？
options: 是
否

en.story: Cheng Hong hates to go to the dentist, because every time he goes to the dentist, he needs to fill a tooth, and that hurts. But Cheng Hong knows, when his tooth hurts, his mother always takes him to the dentist. Now Cheng Hong's tooth hurts a lot, but when his mother notices he looks uncomfortable, she asks him: "Cheng Hong, does your tooth hurt?" Cheng Hong says: "No, mom."
en.question: Does Cheng Hong tell the truth?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 成弘讨厌去看牙医，因为每次他去看牙医时都需要补牙，而那很痛。但成弘知道，当他牙痛时，他的母亲总会带他去看牙医。现在成弘牙痛得很厉害，但当他的母亲注意到他看起来不舒服，问他：“成弘，你牙痛吗？”成弘说：“不，妈妈。”
zh.question: 成弘说的是真的吗？
options: 是
不是

en.story: Mr. Zhao is a respected doctor with exceptional medical skills, often having many patients waiting in line for consultations. However, he is someone who cares deeply about others' opinions. A while back, Mr. Li's cow had damaged Mr. Zhao's vegetable garden, leading to a heated argument between them. This incident, though, is now in the past for Mr. Zhao. One day, Mr. Li approached Mr. Zhao, hoping he could help figure out why his cow suddenly stopped eating. Upon hearing it was for the cow, Mr. Zhao told Mr. Li, "I'm too busy lately, with several surgeries lined up. It's better for you to find another veterinarian to take a look." Despite some disappointment, Mr. Li thanked Mr. Zhao and turned away.
en.question: Why does Mr. Zhao say so?
options: Mr. Zhao often has many patients waiting for consultations, and he is indeed very busy recently.
Mr. Zhao harbors some resentment towards Mr. Li's cow for previously damaging his vegetable garden, so he doesn't want to help.
Mr. Zhao actually doesn't like Mr. Li, so when he seeks help, Mr. Zhao deliberately finds excuses to decline.
Mr. Zhao is afraid that if people in the village see him unable to treat the cow, it lowers his respected status. Therefore, he finds a reason to decline.

zh.story: 赵先生是一名受人尊敬的医生，他的医术高超，常常有很多病人排队等着看诊。但他是一位很在意别人看法的人。李老头家的牛曾经破坏过赵医生家的菜园子，两人因此吵过架。现在这事在赵医生心理也过去了。有一天，李老头找到了赵先生，希望他能帮忙看看他家的牛为何突然不吃东西。赵先生一听是给牛看病，他告诉李老头：“最近我太忙了，一连有好几个手术要做，你最好找其他的兽医来看看。”李老头虽然有些失望，但他还是感谢赵先生并转身离去。
zh.question: 赵先生为什么这么说？
options: 赵先生经常有很多病人等着看诊，确实最近太忙了。
赵先生对李老头家的牛有些怨恨，因为那头牛之前破坏了他的菜园，所以他不想帮忙。
赵先生其实并不喜欢李老头，所以当他求助时，赵先生故意找理由推脱。
赵医生怕村里人看到他不会给牛治病，降低了在人们心中的尊敬地位。因此找了一个理由推脱。

en.story: In a high-end office building, Mr. Zhang is a well-known entrepreneur, his company always is considered as the industry leader. One Monday, the company's competitors suddenly claim that Mr. Zhang's company has serious financial flaws, and they imply that they are about to face bankruptcy. When facing questions from reporters, Mr. Zhang firmly denies these allegations, stating that the company's financial situation always is very healthy.
en.question: Why does Mr. Zhang say this?
options: Mr. Zhang says this because he really does not know about the financial flaws in the company, he is deceived by other senior executives of the company.

Mr. Zhang denies the existence of financial flaws in order to protect the company's image, avoid investors and partners losing confidence, and ensure the stability of the company's stock price and market value.
Mr. Zhang actually secretly plans to sell the company, he denies the financial flaws in order to increase the company's valuation before selling.
Mr. Zhang wants to deceive his peers in this way, and seize their market when they are unprepared.

zh.story: 在高级写字楼内，张总是知名的企业家，他的公司一直被认为是行业的领头羊。某个星期一，公司的竞争对手突然宣称张总的公司存在严重的财务漏洞，并暗示他们即将面临破产。在面对记者提问时，张总坚决否认这些指控，表示公司的财务状况一直非常健康。
zh.question: 张总为什么这么说？
options: 张总这么说是因为他真的不知道公司存在财务漏洞的事情，他被公司的其他高层所蒙蔽了。
张总否认财务漏洞的存在是为了保护公司的形象，避免投资者和合作伙伴失去信心，确保公司的股价和市值稳定。
张总其实已经秘密计划出售公司，他否认财务漏洞是为了在出售前提高公司的估值。
张总想通过这种方法欺骗同行，在他们毫无防备的时候抢占他们的市场。

en.story: Miss Zhou is a well-known novelist, famous for drawing inspiration from her rich life experiences for her works. At a literary symposium, an enthusiastic reader asks her if she ever experiences the intense love story described in her novel. Miss Zhou smiles and answers that her inspiration mostly comes from the books and movies she reads, and her own life is relatively plain. In fact, she has a passionate but short-lived romance, which directly influences her creation.
en.question: Why does Miss Zhou say this?
options: Miss Zhou says this because she hopes to encourage readers to believe that good novel creation can rely entirely on imagination, not on personal experience.
Miss Zhou just gets nominated for an important literary award, she says this to show her professionalism and dedication as a writer.
Miss Zhou says this because she wants to protect her privacy, she does not want to publicly discuss her personal life, especially her emotional experiences.
Miss Zhou is misunderstood in a previous interview, she deliberately answers this way to avoid being misunderstood again or causing unnecessary controversy.

zh.story: 周小姐是一名知名的小说家，以其丰富的生活经历为她的作品提供灵感而著称。在一个文学座谈会上，一位热心的读者问她是否曾经经历过她小说中描述的一段激烈的爱情故事。周小姐微笑着回答说，她的灵感大多来自于她阅读的书籍和电影，而她自己的生活相对平淡。实际上，她曾有过一段热烈但短暂的恋情，这直接影响了她的创作。
zh.question: 周小姐为什么这么说？
options: 周小姐这么说是因为她希望鼓励读者相信，好的小说创作完全可以依靠想象力，而不必依赖个人经历。
周小姐刚被提名了一个重要的文学奖项，她说这些是为了表现出她作为作家的专业性和奉献精神。
周小姐这么说是因为她想保护自己的隐私，不想公开讨论她的个人生活，尤其是她的感情经历。
周小姐之前在一次采访中被误解，她故意这样回答，以避免再次被误解或产生不必要的争议。

en.story: Mr. Yang is a senior manager of a large company. At a company meeting, a department head asks Mr. Yang if he supports a controversial restructuring plan recently proposed. Mr. Yang replies that he fully supports this plan, believes it is the right direction for the company's development, and change is crucial for the company's long-term success. Mr. Yang's assistant knows that actually, due to the upcoming board of directors meeting, Mr. Yang has serious concerns about this plan.
en.question: Does Mr. Yang tell the truth?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 杨先生是一家大型公司的高级经理，在一次公司会议上，一位部门主管问杨先生是否支持最近提出的一项具有争议的重组计划。杨先生回答说，他完全支持这个计划，认为这是公司发展的正确方向，变革对于公司的长期成功至关重要。杨先生的助理知道其实由于临近董事会，杨先生对这个计划有严重的顾虑。
zh.question: 杨先生说的是真的吗？
options: 是
不是

en.story: CEO Zhao invites his business partner, Manager Wang, to a high-end restaurant for dinner. At the dinner table, CEO Zhao notices that Manager Wang shows great interest in a dish, but in fact, this dish is a bit salty. Then, CEO Zhao immediately praises that the taste of this dish is just right.
en.question: Why does Mr. Zhao say this?
options: Mr. Zhao thinks this dish is really delicious, so he tells the truth.
Mr. Zhao wants to please Manager Wang in order to gain an advantageous position in future business cooperation.
Mr. Zhao is a regular customer of this restaurant, out of respect for the restaurant, he always praises every dish.
Mr. Zhao does this out of politeness and social customs, in order to avoid embarrassment and maintain a harmonious dining atmosphere, so he chooses to praise this dish.

zh.story: 赵总邀请了他的商业伙伴王经理到一家高级餐厅共进晚餐。餐桌上，赵总发现王经理对一道菜颇有兴趣，但实际上这道菜稍微有些咸，随后赵总立即称赞这道菜的味道恰到好处。
zh.question: 赵总为什么这么说？
options: 赵总认为这道菜真的很好吃，所以他说的是实话。
赵总想讨好王经理，以便在未来的商业合作中占据有利地位。
赵总是这家餐厅的常客，出于对餐厅的尊重，他总是称赞每一道菜。
赵总是出于礼貌和社交习惯，为了避免尴尬和维护和谐的餐桌氛围，所以选择称赞这道菜。

en.story: Zhang Hua receives an invitation to attend a wedding of an important client. The wedding is too luxurious and impractical. At the wedding, the client asks Zhang Hua about his opinion on the wedding. Zhang Hua smiles and responds that the wedding is very wonderful and unforgettable. His answer makes the client very happy because this client spends a lot of time and money to prepare for this wedding.
en.question: Why does Zhang Hua say this?
options: Zhang Hua says this because he truly thinks the wedding is very exciting and unforgettable.
Zhang Hua tries to get extra business benefits from the client by praising the wedding.
Zhang Hua has some misunderstandings with the client before, he says this to make up for the previous unpleasantness.
Zhang Hua says this because he is out of social politeness, wants to avoid hurting the client's feelings, and maintains a good client relationship.

zh.story: 张华被邀请参加一个重要客户的婚礼，婚礼过于奢华且不实用。在婚礼上，客户问张华对婚礼的看法。张华微笑着回答说婚礼非常精彩且难忘。他的回答让客户非常高兴，因为这位客户花费了大量时间和金钱来筹备这场婚礼。
zh.question: 张华为什么这么说？
options: 张华这么说是因为他真的认为婚礼非常精彩且难忘。
张华试图通过夸赞婚礼来获得客户的额外商业优惠。
张华之前和客户有过一些误会，他这样说是为了弥补之前的不愉快。
张华这么说是因为他出于社交礼貌，想要避免伤害客户的感情，同时保持良好的客户关系。

en.story: Uncle Zhang prepares a special dish for the community's Spring Festival gathering. At the party, Aunt Wang tries this dish and feels something is off about the taste. When Uncle Zhang asks her opinion about the dish, Aunt Wang smiles and says this is one of the most delicious dishes she ever eats.
en.question: Does Aunt Wang tell the truth?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 张伯伯为社区的春节聚会准备了一道特色菜肴。在聚会上，王阿姨尝试了这道菜，觉得味道有些不对劲。当张伯伯询问她对菜肴的看法时，王阿姨微笑着说这是她吃过的最美味的菜肴之一。
zh.question: 王阿姨说的是真的吗？
options: 是
不是

en.story: Zhang Wei is a highly respected painter. His good friend Li Hua, although he loves painting, his skills are average. One day, Li Hua excitedly shows his latest work, asking for Zhang Wei's opinion. Zhang Wei praises the unique color and Li Hua's creativity when he sees this painting.
en.question: Does Zhang Wei tell the truth?
options: Yes
No

zh.story: 张伟是一位备受尊敬的画家。他的好友李华，虽然热爱绘画，但技艺平平。有一天，李华兴奋地展示了他的最新作品，询问张伟的意见。张伟看到这幅画作时赞扬了画作的独特色彩和李华的创造力。
zh.question: 张伟说的是真的吗？
options: 是
不是

en.story: Zhao Xiao receives love from teachers and students because of his excellent grades and friendly attitude. One day, his roommate Wang Ming feels depressed because of his unsatisfactory final exam results. Wang Ming shows his report card to Zhao Xiao, asking Zhao Xiao what he thinks of his grades. After seeing the report card, although Zhao Xiao thinks Wang Ming probably does not study hard, he still encourages Wang Ming, saying the grades are not bad, and as long as he works a little harder, he can improve.
en.question: Why does Zhao Xiao say this?
options: Zhao Xiao says this because he really thinks Wang Ming's grades are not bad, he just needs to work harder.
Zhao Xiao just gets elected as the class representative, he answers this way to establish an image of supporting and encouraging classmates.
Zhao Xiao says this because he wants to encourage Wang Ming, and maintain their friendly relationship and the harmonious atmosphere of the dormitory.
Zhao Xiao is also dissatisfied with the exam, he says these to cover up his own sense of disappointment.

zh.story: 赵晓因为成绩优异和待人友好而受到师生的喜爱。一天，他的室友王明因为期末考试成绩不理想而感到沮丧。王明向赵晓展示了他的成绩单，询问赵晓对他的成绩有何看法。赵晓看到成绩单后，虽然心里觉得王明可能没有认真复习，但他还是鼓励王明说成绩还不错，并且只要再努力一点就能提高。
zh.question: 赵晓为什么这么说？
options: 赵晓这么说是因为他真的认为王明的成绩还不错，只是需要再加把劲。
